verses.en: Righteous lips are the delight of kings; and they love him that speaketh right.

verses.he: חֲמַת מֶ֥לֶךְ מַלְאֲכֵי מָ֑וֶת וְאִ֖ישׁ חָכָ֣ם יְכַפְּרֶֽנָּה׃
verses.en: The wrath of a king is as messengers of death; but a wise man will pacify it.

verses.he: בְּאוֹר פְּנֵי מֶ֥לֶךְ חַיִּ֑ים וּ֝רְצוֹנ֗וֹ כְּעָ֣ב מַלְקֽוֹשׁ׃
verses.en: In the light of the king's countenance is life; and his favour is as a cloud of the latter rain.

verses.he: קְֽנֹה חָכְמָ֗ה מַה טּ֥וֹב מֵחָר֑וּץ וּקְנ֥וֹת בִּ֝ינָ֗ה נִבְחָ֥ר מִכָּֽסֶף׃
verses.en: How much better is it to get wisdom than gold! yea, to get understanding is rather to be chosen than silver.

verses.he: מְסִלַּ֣ת יְ֭שָׁרִים ס֣וּר מֵרָ֑ע שֹׁמֵ֥ר נַ֝פְשׁ֗וֹ נֹצֵ֥ר דַּרְכּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil; he that keepeth his way preserveth his soul.

verses.he: לִפְנֵי שֶׁ֥בֶר גָּא֑וֹן וְלִפְנֵ֥י כִ֝שָּׁל֗וֹן גֹּ֣בַהּ רֽוּחַ׃
verses.en: Pride goeth before destruction, and a haughty spirit before a fall.

verses.he: ט֣וֹב שְׁפַל ר֭וּחַ אֶת ענייםענייםעֲנָוִ֑יםמֵֽחַלֵּ֥ק שָׁ֝לָ֗ל אֶת גֵּאִֽים׃
verses.en: Better it is to be of a lowly spirit with the humble, than to divide the spoil with the proud.

verses.he: מַשְׂכִּ֣יל עַל דָּ֭בָר יִמְצָא ט֑וֹב וּבוֹטֵ֖חַ בַּיהוָ֣ה אַשְׁרָֽיו׃
verses.en: He that giveth heed unto the word shall find good; and whoso trusteth in HaShem, happy is he.

verses.he: לַחֲכַם לֵ֭ב יִקָּרֵ֣א נָב֑וֹן וּמֶ֥תֶק שְׂ֝פָתַ֗יִם יֹסִ֥יף לֶֽקַח׃
verses.en: The wise in heart is called a man of discernment; and the sweetness of the lips increaseth learning.

verses.he: מְק֣וֹר חַ֭יִּים שֵׂ֣כֶל בְּעָלָ֑יו וּמוּסַ֖ר אֱוִלִ֣ים אִוֶּֽלֶת׃
verses.en: Understanding is a fountain of life unto him that hath it; but folly is the chastisement of fools.

verses.he: לֵ֣ב חָ֭כָם יַשְׂכִּ֣יל פִּ֑יהוּ וְעַל שְׂ֝פָתָ֗יו יֹסִ֥יף לֶֽקַח׃
verses.en: The heart of the wise teacheth his mouth, and addeth learning to his lips.

verses.he: צוּף דְּ֭בַשׁ אִמְרֵי נֹ֑עַם מָת֥וֹק לַ֝נֶּפֶשׁ וּמַרְפֵּ֥א לָעָֽצֶם׃
verses.en: Pleasant words are as a honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.

verses.he: יֵ֤שׁ דֶּ֣רֶךְ יָ֭שָׁר לִפְנֵי אִ֑ישׁ וְ֝אַחֲרִיתָ֗הּ דַּרְכֵי מָֽוֶת׃
verses.en: There is a way which seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death.

verses.he: נֶ֣פֶשׁ עָ֭מֵל עָ֣מְלָה לּ֑וֹ כִּֽי אָכַ֖ף עָלָ֣יו פִּֽיהוּ׃
verses.en: The hunger of the labouring man laboureth for him; for his mouth compelleth him.

verses.he: אִ֣ישׁ בְּ֭לִיַּעַל כֹּרֶ֣ה רָעָ֑ה וְעַל שפתיושפתיושְׂ֝פָת֗וֹכְּאֵ֣שׁ צָרָֽבֶת׃
verses.en: An ungodly man diggeth up evil, and in his lips there is as a burning fire.

verses.he: אִ֣ישׁ תַּ֭הְפֻּכוֹת יְשַׁלַּ֣ח מָד֑וֹן וְ֝נִרְגָּ֗ ןמַפְרִ֥יד אַלּֽוּף׃
verses.en: A froward man soweth strife; and a whisperer separateth familiar friends.

verses.he: אִ֣ישׁ חָ֭מָס יְפַתֶּ֣ה רֵעֵ֑הוּ וְ֝הוֹלִיכ֗וֹ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ לֹא טֽוֹב׃
verses.en: A man of violence enticeth his neighbour, and leadeth him into a way that is not good.

verses.he: עֹצֶ֣ה עֵ֭ינָיו לַחְשֹׁ֣ב תַּהְפֻּכ֑וֹת קֹרֵ֥ץ שְׂ֝פָתָ֗יו כִּלָּ֥ה רָעָֽה׃
verses.en: He that shutteth his eyes, it is to devise froward things; he that biteth his lips bringeth evil to pass.

verses.he: עֲטֶ֣רֶת תִּפְאֶ֣רֶת שֵׂיבָ֑ה בְּדֶ֥רֶךְ צְ֝דָקָ֗ה תִּמָּצֵֽא׃
verses.en: The hoary head is a crown of glory, it is found in the way of righteousness.

verses.he: ט֤וֹב אֶ֣רֶךְ אַ֭פַּיִם מִגִּבּ֑וֹר וּמֹשֵׁ֥ל בְּ֝רוּח֗וֹ מִלֹּכֵ֥ד עִֽיר׃
verses.en: He that is slow to anger is better than the mighty; and he that ruleth his spirit than he that taketh a city.

verses.he: בַּ֭חֵיק יוּטַ֣ל אֶת הַגּוֹרָ֑ל וּ֝מֵיְהוָ֗ה כָּל מִשְׁפָּטֽוֹ׃
verses.en: The lot is cast into the lap; but the whole disposing thereof is of HaShem.

verses.he: ט֤וֹב פַּ֣ת חֲ֭רֵבָה וְשַׁלְוָה בָ֑הּ מִ֝בַּ֗יִת מָלֵ֥א זִבְחֵי רִֽיב׃
verses.en: Better is a dry morsel and quietness therewith, than a house full of feasting with strife.

verses.he: עֶֽבֶד מַשְׂכִּ֗יל יִ֭מְשֹׁל בְּבֵ֣ן מֵבִ֑ישׁ וּבְת֥וֹךְ אַ֝חִ֗ים יַחֲלֹ֥ק נַחֲלָֽה׃
verses.en: A servant that dealeth wisely shall have rule over a son that dealeth shamefully, and shall have part of the inheritance among the brethren.

verses.he: מַצְרֵ֣ף לַ֭כֶּסֶף וְכ֣וּר לַזָּהָ֑ב וּבֹחֵ֖ן לִבּ֣וֹת יְהוָֽה׃
verses.en: The refining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold; but HaShem trieth the hearts.

verses.he: מֵ֭רַע מַקְשִׁ֣יב עַל שְׂפַת אָ֑וֶן שֶׁ֥קֶר מֵ֝זִין עַל לְשׁ֥וֹן הַוֺּֽת׃
verses.en: A evil-doer giveth heed to wicked lips; and a liar giveth ear to a mischievous tongue.

verses.he: לֹעֵ֣ג לָ֭רָשׁ חֵרֵ֣ף עֹשֵׂ֑הוּ שָׂמֵ֥חַ לְ֝אֵ֗יד לֹ֣א יִנָּקֶֽה׃
verses.en: Whoso mocketh the poor blasphemeth his Maker; and he that is glad at calamity shall not be unpunished.

verses.he: עֲטֶ֣רֶת זְ֭קֵנִים בְּנֵ֣י בָנִ֑ים וְתִפְאֶ֖רֶת בָּנִ֣ים אֲבוֹתָֽם׃
verses.en: Children's children are the crown of old men; and the glory of children are their fathers.

verses.he: לֹא נָאוָ֣ה לְנָבָ֣ל שְׂפַת יֶ֑תֶר אַ֝֗ף כִּֽי לְנָדִ֥יב שְׂפַת שָֽׁקֶר׃
verses.en: Overbearing speech becometh not a churl; much less do lying lips a prince.

verses.he: אֶֽבֶן חֵ֣ן הַ֭שֹּׁחַד בְּעֵינֵ֣י בְעָלָ֑יו אֶֽל כָּל אֲשֶׁ֖ר יִפְנֶ֣ה יַשְׂכִּֽיל׃
verses.en: A gift is as a precious stone in the eyes of him that hath it; whithersoever he turneth, he prospereth.

verses.he: מְֽכַסֶּה פֶּ֭שַׁע מְבַקֵּ֣שׁ אַהֲבָ֑ה וְשֹׁנֶ֥ה בְ֝דָבָ֗ר מַפְרִ֥יד אַלּֽוּף׃
verses.en: He that covereth a transgression seeketh love; but he that harpeth on a matter estrangeth a familiar friend.

verses.he: תֵּ֣חַת גְּעָרָ֣ה בְמֵבִ֑ין מֵהַכּ֖וֹת כְּסִ֣יל מֵאָֽה׃
verses.en: A rebuke entereth deeper into a man of understanding than a hundred stripes into a fool.

verses.he: אַךְ מְרִ֥י יְבַקֶּשׁ רָ֑ע וּמַלְאָ֥ךְ אַ֝כְזָרִ֗י יְשֻׁלַּח בּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: An rebellious man seeketh only evil; therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.

verses.he: פָּג֬וֹשׁ דֹּ֣ב שַׁכּ֣וּל בְּאִ֑ישׁ וְאַל כְּ֝סִ֗יל בְּאִוַּלְתּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Let a bear robbed of her whelps meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.

verses.he: מֵשִׁ֣יב רָ֭עָה תַּ֣חַת טוֹבָ֑ה לֹא תמישתמישתָמ֥וּשׁרָ֝עָ֗ה מִבֵּיתֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Whoso rewardeth evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.

verses.he: פּ֣וֹטֵֽר מַ֭יִם רֵאשִׁ֣ית מָד֑וֹן וְלִפְנֵ֥י הִ֝תְגַּלַּ֗ע הָרִ֥יב נְטֽוֹשׁ׃
verses.en: The beginning of strife is as when one letteth out water; therefore leave off contention, before the quarrel break out.

verses.he: מַצְדִּ֣יק רָ֭שָׁע וּמַרְשִׁ֣יעַ צַדִּ֑יק תּוֹעֲבַ֥ת יְ֝הוָ֗ה גַּם שְׁנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.en: He that justifieth the wicked, and he that condemneth the righteous, even they both are an abomination to HaShem.

verses.he: לָמָּה זֶּ֣ה מְחִ֣יר בְּיַד כְּסִ֑יל לִקְנ֖וֹת חָכְמָ֣ה וְלֶב אָֽיִן׃
verses.en: Wherefore is there a price in the hand of a fool to buy wisdom, seeing he hath no understanding?

verses.he: בְּכָל עֵ֭ת אֹהֵ֣ב הָרֵ֑עַ וְאָ֥ח לְ֝צָרָ֗ה יִוָּלֵֽד׃
verses.en: A friend loveth at all times, and a brother is born for adversity.

verses.he: אָדָ֣ם חֲסַר לֵ֭ב תּוֹקֵ֣עַ כָּ֑ף עֹרֵ֥ב עֲ֝רֻבָּ֗ה לִפְנֵ֥י רֵעֵֽהוּ׃
verses.en: A man void of understanding is he that striketh hands, and becometh surety in the presence of his neighbour.

verses.he: אֹ֣הֵֽב פֶּ֭שַׁע אֹהֵ֣ב מַצָּ֑ה מַגְבִּ֥יהַּ פִּ֝תְח֗וֹ מְבַקֶּשׁ שָֽׁבֶר׃
verses.en: He loveth transgression that loveth strife; he that exalteth his gate seeketh destruction.

verses.he: עִקֶּשׁ לֵ֭ב לֹ֣א יִמְצָא ט֑וֹב וְנֶהְפָּ֥ךְ בִּ֝לְשׁוֹנ֗וֹ יִפּ֥וֹל בְּרָעָֽה׃
verses.en: He that hath a froward heart findeth no good; and he that hath a perverse tongue falleth into evil.

verses.he: יֹלֵ֣ד כְּ֭סִיל לְת֣וּגָה ל֑וֹ וְלֹֽא יִ֝שְׂמַ֗ח אֲבִ֣י נָבָֽל׃
verses.en: He that begetteth a fool doeth it to his sorrow; and the father of a churl hath no joy.

verses.he: לֵ֣ב שָׂ֭מֵחַ יֵיטִ֣ב גֵּהָ֑ה וְר֥וּחַ נְ֝כֵאָ֗ה תְּיַבֶּשׁ גָּֽרֶם׃
verses.en: A merry heart is a good medicine; but a broken spirit drieth the bones.

verses.he: שֹׁ֣חַד מֵ֭חֵיק רָשָׁ֣ע יִקָּ֑ח לְ֝הַטּ֗וֹת אָרְח֥וֹת מִשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.en: A wicked man taketh a gift out of the bosom, to pervert the ways of justice.

verses.he: אֶת פְּנֵ֣י מֵבִ֣ין חָכְמָ֑ה וְעֵינֵ֥י כְ֝סִ֗יל בִּקְצֵה אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.en: Wisdom is before him that hath understanding; but the eyes of a fool are in the ends of the earth.

verses.he: כַּ֣עַס לְ֭אָבִיו בֵּ֣ן כְּסִ֑יל וּ֝מֶ֗מֶר לְיוֹלַדְתּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: A foolish son is vexation to his father, and bitterness to her that bore him.

verses.he: גַּ֤ם עֲנ֣וֹשׁ לַצַּדִּ֣יק לֹא ט֑וֹב לְהַכּ֖וֹת נְדִיבִ֣ים עַל יֹֽשֶׁר׃
verses.en: To punish also the righteous is not good, nor to strike the noble for their uprightness.

verses.he: חוֹשֵׂ֣ךְ אֲ֭מָרָיו יוֹדֵ֣עַ דָּ֑עַת וקרוקריְקַר ר֝֗וּחַ אִ֣ישׁ תְּבוּנָֽה׃
verses.en: He that spareth his words hath knowledge; and he that husbandeth his spirit is a man of discernment.

verses.he: גַּ֤ם אֱוִ֣יל מַ֭חֲרִישׁ חָכָ֣ם יֵחָשֵׁ֑ב אֹטֵ֖ם שְׂפָתָ֣יו נָבֽוֹן׃
verses.en: Even a fool, when he holdeth his peace, is counted wise; and he that shutteth his lips is esteemed as a man of understanding.

verses.he: לְֽ֭תַאֲוָה יְבַקֵּ֣שׁ נִפְרָ֑ד בְּכָל תּ֝וּשִׁיָּ֗ה יִתְגַּלָּֽע׃
verses.en: He that separateth himself seeketh his own desire, and snarlest against all sound wisdom.

verses.he: לֹֽא יַחְפֹּ֣ץ כְּ֭סִיל בִּתְבוּנָ֑ה כִּ֝֗י אִֽם בְּהִתְגַּלּ֥וֹת לִבּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: A fool hath no delight in understanding, but only that his heart may lay itself bare.

verses.he: בְּֽבוֹא רָ֭שָׁע בָּ֣א גַם בּ֑וּז וְֽעִם קָל֥וֹן חֶרְפָּֽה׃
verses.en: When the wicked cometh, there cometh also contempt, and with ignominy reproach.

verses.he: מַ֣יִם עֲ֭מֻקִּים דִּבְרֵ֣י פִי אִ֑ישׁ נַ֥חַל נֹ֝בֵ֗עַ מְק֣וֹר חָכְמָֽה׃
verses.en: The words of a man's mouth are as deep waters; a flowing brook, a fountain of wisdom.

verses.he: שְׂאֵ֣ת פְּנֵי רָשָׁ֣ע לֹא ט֑וֹב לְהַטּ֥וֹת צַ֝דִּ֗יק בַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.en: It is not good to respect the person of the wicked, so as to turn aside the righteous in judgment.

verses.he: שִׂפְתֵ֣י כְ֭סִיל יָבֹ֣אֽוּ בְרִ֑יב וּ֝פִ֗יו לְֽמַהֲלֻמ֥וֹת יִקְרָֽא׃
verses.en: A fool's lips enter into contention, and his mouth calleth for strokes.

verses.he: פִּֽי כְ֭סִיל מְחִתָּה ל֑וֹ וּ֝שְׂפָתָ֗יו מוֹקֵ֥שׁ נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.en: A fool's mouth is his ruin, and his lips are the snare of his soul.

verses.he: דִּבְרֵ֣י נִ֭רְגָּן כְּמִֽתְלַהֲמִ֑ים וְ֝הֵ֗ם יָרְד֥וּ חַדְרֵי בָֽטֶן׃
verses.en: The words of a whisperer are as dainty morsels, and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly.

verses.he: גַּ֭ם מִתְרַפֶּ֣ה בִמְלַאכְתּ֑וֹ אָ֥ח ה֝֗וּא לְבַ֣עַל מַשְׁחִֽית׃
verses.en: Even one that is slack in his work is brother to him that is a destroyer.

verses.he: מִגְדַּל עֹ֭ז שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה בּֽוֹ יָר֖וּץ צַדִּ֣יק וְנִשְׂגָּֽב׃
verses.en: The name of HaShem is a strong tower: the righteous runneth into it, and is set up on high.

verses.he: ה֣וֹן עָ֭שִׁיר קִרְיַ֣ת עֻזּ֑וֹ וּכְחוֹמָ֥ה נִ֝שְׂגָּבָ֗ה בְּמַשְׂכִּיתֽוֹ׃
verses.en: The rich man's wealth is his strong city, and as a high wall in his own conceit.

verses.he: לִפְנֵי שֶׁ֭בֶר יִגְבַּ֣הּ לֵב אִ֑ישׁ וְלִפְנֵ֖י כָב֣וֹד עֲנָוָֽה׃
verses.en: Before destruction the heart of a man is haughty, and before honour goeth humility.

verses.he: מֵשִׁ֣יב דָּ֭בָר בְּטֶ֣רֶם יִשְׁמָ֑ע אִוֶּ֥לֶת הִיא ל֝֗וֹ וּכְלִמָּֽה׃
verses.en: He that giveth answer before he heareth, it is folly and confusion unto him.

verses.he: רֽוּחַ אִ֭ישׁ יְכַלְכֵּ֣ל מַחֲלֵ֑הוּ וְר֥וּחַ נְ֝כֵאָ֗ה מִ֣י יִשָּׂאֶֽנָּה׃
verses.en: The spirit of a man will sustain his infirmity; but a broken spirit who can bear?

verses.he: לֵ֣ב נָ֭בוֹן יִקְנֶה דָּ֑עַת וְאֹ֥זֶן חֲ֝כָמִ֗ים תְּבַקֶּשׁ דָּֽעַת׃
verses.en: The heart of the prudent getteth knowledge; and the ear of the wise seeketh knowledge.

verses.he: מַתָּ֣ן אָ֭דָם יַרְחִ֣יב ל֑וֹ וְלִפְנֵ֖י גְדֹלִ֣ים יַנְחֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.en: A man's gift maketh room for him, and bringeth him before great men.

verses.he: צַדִּ֣יק הָרִאשׁ֣וֹן בְּרִיב֑וֹ יבאיבאוּבָֽא רֵ֝עֵ֗הוּ וַחֲקָרֽוֹ׃
verses.en: He that pleadeth his cause first seemeth just; but his neighbour cometh and searcheth him out.

verses.he: מִ֭דְיָנִים יַשְׁבִּ֣ית הַגּוֹרָ֑ל וּבֵ֖ין עֲצוּמִ֣ים יַפְרִֽיד׃
verses.en: The lot causeth strife to cease, and parteth asunder the contentious.

verses.he: אָ֗ח נִפְשָׁ֥ע מִקִּרְיַת עֹ֑ז ומדוניםומדוניםוּ֝מִדְיָנִ֗יםכִּבְרִ֥יחַ אַרְמֽוֹן׃
verses.en: A brother offended is harder to be won than a strong city; and their contentions are like the bars of a castle.

verses.he: מִפְּרִ֣י פִי אִ֭ישׁ תִּשְׂבַּ֣ע בִּטְנ֑וֹ תְּבוּאַ֖ת שְׂפָתָ֣יו יִשְׂבָּֽע׃
verses.en: A man's belly shall be filled with the fruit of his mouth; with the increase of his lips shall he be satisfied.

verses.he: מָ֣וֶת וְ֭חַיִּים בְּיַד לָשׁ֑וֹן וְ֝אֹהֲבֶ֗יהָ יֹאכַ֥ל פִּרְיָֽהּ׃
verses.en: Death and life are in the power of the tongue; and they that indulge it shall eat the fruit thereof.

verses.he: מָצָ֣א אִ֭שָּׁה מָ֣צָא ט֑וֹב וַיָּ֥פֶק רָ֝צ֗וֹן מֵיְהוָֽה׃
verses.en: Whoso findeth a wife findeth a great good, and obtaineth favour of HaShem.

verses.he: תַּחֲנוּנִ֥ים יְדַבֶּר רָ֑שׁ וְ֝עָשִׁ֗יר יַעֲנֶ֥ה עַזּֽוֹת׃
verses.en: The poor useth entreaties; but the rich answereth impudently.

verses.he: אִ֣ישׁ רֵ֭עִים לְהִתְרֹעֵ֑עַ וְיֵ֥שׁ אֹ֝הֵ֗ב דָּבֵ֥ק מֵאָֽח׃
verses.en: There are friends that one hath to his own hurt; but there is a friend that sticketh closer than a brother.

verses.he: טֽוֹב רָ֭שׁ הוֹלֵ֣ךְ בְּתֻמּ֑וֹ מֵעִקֵּ֥שׁ שְׂ֝פָתָ֗יו וְה֣וּא כְסִֽיל׃
verses.en: Better is the poor that walketh in his integrity than he that is perverse in his lips and a fool at the same time.

verses.he: גַּ֤ם בְּלֹא דַ֣עַת נֶ֣פֶשׁ לֹא ט֑וֹב וְאָ֖ץ בְּרַגְלַ֣יִם חוֹטֵֽא׃
verses.en: Also, that the soul be without knowledge is not good; and he that hasteth with his feet sinneth.

verses.he: אִוֶּ֣לֶת אָ֭דָם תְּסַלֵּ֣ף דַּרְכּ֑וֹ וְעַל יְ֝הוָ֗ה יִזְעַ֥ף לִבּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: The foolishness of man perverteth his way; and his heart fretteth against HaShem.

verses.he: ה֗וֹן יֹ֭סִיף רֵעִ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים וְ֝דָ֗ל מֵרֵ֥עהוּ יִפָּרֵֽד׃
verses.en: Wealth addeth many friends; but as for the poor, his friend separateth himself from him.

verses.he: עֵ֣ד שְׁ֭קָרִים לֹ֣א יִנָּקֶ֑ה וְיָפִ֥יחַ כְּ֝זָבִ֗ים לֹ֣א יִמָּלֵֽט׃
verses.en: A false witness shall not be unpunished; and he that breatheth forth lies shall not escape.

verses.he: רַ֭בִּים יְחַלּ֣וּ פְנֵֽי נָדִ֑יב וְכָל הָ֝רֵ֗עַ לְאִ֣ישׁ מַתָּֽן׃
verses.en: Many will entreat the favour of the liberal man; and every man is a friend to him that giveth gifts.

verses.he: כָּ֥ל אֲחֵי רָ֨שׁ שְֽׂנֵאֻ֗הוּ אַ֤ף כִּ֣י מְ֭רֵעֵהוּ רָחֲק֣וּ מִמֶּ֑נּוּ מְרַדֵּ֖ף אֲמָרִ֣ים לאלאלוֹ הֵֽמָּה׃
verses.en: All the brethren of the poor do hate him; how much more do his friends go far from him! He that pursueth words, they turn against him.

verses.he: קֹֽנֶה לֵּ֭ב אֹהֵ֣ב נַפְשׁ֑וֹ שֹׁמֵ֥ר תְּ֝בוּנָ֗ה לִמְצֹא טֽוֹב׃
verses.en: He that getteth wisdom loveth his own soul; he that keepeth understanding shall find good.

verses.he: עֵ֣ד שְׁ֭קָרִים לֹ֣א יִנָּקֶ֑ה וְיָפִ֖יחַ כְּזָבִ֣ים יֹאבֵֽד׃ פ
verses.en: A false witness shall not be unpunished; and he that breatheth forth lies shall perish.

verses.he: לֹֽא נָאוֶ֣ה לִכְסִ֣יל תַּעֲנ֑וּג אַ֝֗ף כִּֽי לְעֶ֤בֶד מְשֹׁ֬ל בְּשָׂרִֽים׃
verses.en: Luxury is not seemly for a fool; much less for a servant to have rule over princes.

verses.he: שֵׂ֣כֶל אָ֭דָם הֶאֱרִ֣יךְ אַפּ֑וֹ וְ֝תִפאַרְתּ֗וֹ עֲבֹ֣ר עַל פָּֽשַׁע׃
verses.en: It is the discretion of a man to be slow to anger, and it is his glory to pass over a transgression.

verses.he: נַ֣הַם כַּ֭כְּפִיר זַ֣עַף מֶ֑לֶךְ וּכְטַ֖ל עַל עֵ֣שֶׂב רְצוֹנֽוֹ׃
verses.en: The king's wrath is as the roaring of a lion; but his favour is as dew upon the grass.

verses.he: הַוֺּ֣ת לְ֭אָבִיו בֵּ֣ן כְּסִ֑יל וְדֶ֥לֶף טֹ֝רֵ֗ד מִדְיְנֵ֥י אִשָּֽׁה׃
verses.en: A foolish son is the calamity of his father; and the contentions of a wife are a continual dropping.

verses.he: בַּ֣יִת וָ֭הוֹן נַחֲלַ֣ת אָב֑וֹת וּ֝מֵיְהוָ֗ה אִשָּׁ֥ה מַשְׂכָּֽלֶת׃
verses.en: House and riches are the inheritance of fathers; but a prudent wife is from HaShem.

verses.he: עַ֭צְלָה תַּפִּ֣יל תַּרְדֵּמָ֑ה וְנֶ֖פֶשׁ רְמִיָּ֣ה תִרְעָֽב׃
verses.en: Slothfulness casteth into a deep sleep; and the idle soul shall suffer hunger.

verses.he: שֹׁמֵ֣ר מִ֭צְוָה שֹׁמֵ֣ר נַפְשׁ֑וֹ בּוֹזֵ֖ה דְרָכָ֣יו יומתיומתיָמֽוּת׃
verses.en: He that keepeth the commandment keepeth his soul; but he that despiseth His ways shall die.

verses.he: מַלְוֵ֣ה יְ֭הוָה ח֣וֹנֵֽן דָּ֑ל וּ֝גְמֻל֗וֹ יְשַׁלֶּם לֽוֹ׃
verses.en: He that is gracious unto the poor lendeth unto HaShem; and his good deed will He repay unto him.

verses.he: יַסֵּ֣ר בִּ֭נְךָ כִּי יֵ֣שׁ תִּקְוָ֑ה וְאֶל הֲ֝מִית֗וֹ אַל תִּשָּׂ֥א נַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃
verses.en: Chasten thy son, for there is hope; but set not thy heart on his destruction.

verses.he: גרלגרלגְּֽדָל חֵ֭מָה נֹ֣שֵׂא עֹ֑נֶשׁ כִּ֥י אִם תַּ֝צִּ֗יל וְע֣וֹד תּוֹסִֽף׃
verses.en: A man of great wrath shall suffer punishment; for if thou interpose, thou wilt add thereto.

verses.he: שְׁמַ֣ע עֵ֭צָה וְקַבֵּ֣ל מוּסָ֑ר לְ֝מַ֗עַן תֶּחְכַּ֥ם בְּאַחֲרִיתֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: Hear counsel, and receive instruction, that thou mayest be wise in thy latter end.

verses.he: רַבּ֣וֹת מַחֲשָׁב֣וֹת בְּלֶב אִ֑ישׁ וַעֲצַ֥ת יְ֝הוָ֗ה הִ֣יא תָקֽוּם׃
verses.en: There are many devices in a man's heart; but the counsel of HaShem, that shall stand.

verses.he: תַּאֲוַ֣ת אָדָ֣ם חַסְדּ֑וֹ וְטֽוֹב רָ֝שׁ מֵאִ֥ישׁ כָּזָֽב׃
verses.en: The lust of a man is his shame; and a poor man is better than a liar.

verses.he: יִרְאַ֣ת יְהוָ֣ה לְחַיִּ֑ים וְשָׂבֵ֥עַ יָ֝לִ֗ין בַּל יִפָּ֥קֶד רָֽע׃
verses.en: The fear of HaShem tendeth to life; and he that hath it shall abide satisfied, he shall not be visited with evil.

verses.he: טָ֘מַ֤ן עָצֵ֣ל יָ֭דוֹ בַּצַּלָּ֑חַת גַּם אֶל פִּ֝֗יהוּ לֹ֣א יְשִׁיבֶֽנָּה׃
verses.en: The sluggard burieth his hand in the dish, and will not so much as bring it back to his mouth.

verses.he: לֵ֣ץ תַּ֭כֶּה וּפֶ֣תִי יַעְרִ֑ם וְהוֹכִ֥יחַ לְ֝נָב֗וֹן יָבִ֥ין דָּֽעַת׃
verses.en: When thou smitest a scorner, the simple will become prudent; and when one that hath understanding is reproved, he will understand knowledge.

verses.he: מְֽשַׁדֶּד אָ֭ב יַבְרִ֣יחַ אֵ֑ם בֵּ֝֗ן מֵבִ֥ישׁ וּמַחְפִּֽיר׃
verses.en: A son that dealeth shamefully and reproachfully will despoil his father, and chase away his mother.

verses.he: חַֽדַל בְּ֭נִי לִשְׁמֹ֣עַ מוּסָ֑ר לִ֝שְׁג֗וֹת מֵֽאִמְרֵי דָֽעַת׃
verses.en: Cease, my son, to hear the instruction that causeth to err from the words of knowledge.

verses.he: עֵ֣ד בְּ֭לִיַּעַל יָלִ֣יץ מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וּפִ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים יְבַלַּע אָֽוֶן׃
verses.en: An ungodly witness mocketh at right; and the mouth of the wicked devoureth iniquity.

verses.he: נָכ֣וֹנוּ לַלֵּצִ֣ים שְׁפָטִ֑ים וּ֝מַהֲלֻמ֗וֹת לְגֵ֣ו כְּסִילִֽים׃
verses.en: Judgments are prepared for scorners, and stripes for the back of fools.

verses.he: לֵ֣ץ הַ֭יַּין הֹמֶ֣ה שֵׁכָ֑ר וְכָל שֹׁ֥גֶה בּ֝֗וֹ לֹ֣א יֶחְכָּֽם׃
verses.en: Wine is a mocker, strong drink is riotous; and whosoever reeleth thereby is not wise.

verses.he: נַ֣הַם כַּ֭כְּפִיר אֵ֣ימַת מֶ֑לֶךְ מִ֝תְעַבְּר֗וֹ חוֹטֵ֥א נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.en: The terror of a king is as the roaring of a lion: he that provoketh him to anger forfeiteth his life.

verses.he: כָּב֣וֹד לָ֭אִישׁ שֶׁ֣בֶת מֵרִ֑יב וְכָל אֱ֝וִ֗יל יִתְגַּלָּֽע׃
verses.en: It is an honour for a man to keep aloof from strife; but every fool will be snarling.

verses.he: מֵ֭חֹרֶף עָצֵ֣ל לֹא יַחֲרֹ֑שׁ ישאלישאלוְשָׁאַ֖לבַּקָּצִ֣יר וָאָֽיִן׃
verses.en: The sluggard will not plow when winter setteth in; therefore he shall beg in harvest, and have nothing.

verses.he: מַ֣יִם עֲ֭מֻקִּים עֵצָ֣ה בְלֶב אִ֑ישׁ וְאִ֖ישׁ תְּבוּנָ֣ה יִדְלֶֽנָּה׃
verses.en: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water; but a man of understanding will draw it out.

verses.he: רָב אָדָ֗ם יִ֭קְרָא אִ֣ישׁ חַסְדּ֑וֹ וְאִ֥ישׁ אֱ֝מוּנִ֗ים מִ֣י יִמְצָֽא׃
verses.en: Most men will proclaim every one his own goodness; but a faithful man who can find?

verses.he: מִתְהַלֵּ֣ךְ בְּתֻמּ֣וֹ צַדִּ֑יק אַשְׁרֵ֖י בָנָ֣יו אַחֲרָֽיו׃
verses.en: He that walketh in his integrity as a just man, happy are his children after him.

verses.he: מֶ֗לֶךְ יוֹשֵׁ֥ב עַל כִּסֵּא דִ֑ין מְזָרֶ֖ה בְעֵינָ֣יו כָּל רָֽע׃
verses.en: A king that sitteth on the throne of judgment scattereth away all evil with his eyes.

verses.he: מִֽי יֹ֭אמַר זִכִּ֣יתִי לִבִּ֑י טָ֝הַ֗רְתִּי מֵחַטָּאתִֽי׃
verses.en: Who can say: 'I have made my heart clean, I am pure from my sin'?

verses.he: אֶ֣בֶן וָ֭אֶבֶן אֵיפָ֣ה וְאֵיפָ֑ה תּוֹעֲבַ֥ת יְ֝הוָ֗ה גַּם שְׁנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.en: Divers weights, and divers measures, both of them alike are abomination to HaShem.

verses.he: גַּ֣ם בְּ֭מַעֲלָלָיו יִתְנַכֶּר נָ֑עַר אִם זַ֖ךְ וְאִם יָשָׁ֣ר פָּעֳלֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Even a child is known by his doings, whether his work be pure, and whether it be right.

verses.he: אֹ֣זֶן שֹׁ֭מַעַת וְעַ֣יִן רֹאָ֑ה יְ֝הוָ֗ה עָשָׂ֥ה גַם שְׁנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.en: The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, HaShem hath made even both of them.

verses.he: אַל תֶּֽאֱהַ֣ב שֵׁ֭נָה פֶּן תִּוָּרֵ֑שׁ פְּקַ֖ח עֵינֶ֣יךָ שְֽׂבַֽע לָֽחֶם׃
verses.en: Love not sleep, lest thou come to poverty; open thine eyes, and thou shalt have bread in plenty.

verses.he: רַ֣ע רַ֭ע יֹאמַ֣ר הַקּוֹנֶ֑ה וְאֹזֵ֥ל ל֝֗וֹ אָ֣ז יִתְהַלָּֽל׃
verses.en: 'It is bad, it is bad', saith the buyer; but when he is gone his way, then he boasteth.

verses.he: יֵ֣שׁ זָ֭הָב וְרָב פְּנִינִ֑ים וּכְלִ֥י יְ֝קָ֗ר שִׂפְתֵי דָֽעַת׃
verses.en: There is gold, and a multitude of rubies; but the lips of knowledge are a precious jewel.

verses.he: לְֽקַח בִּ֭גְדוֹ כִּי עָ֣רַב זָ֑ר וּבְעַ֖ד נכריםנכריםנָכְרִיָּ֣החַבְלֵֽהוּ׃
verses.en: Take his garment that is surety for a stranger; and hold him in pledge that is surety for an alien woman.

verses.he: עָרֵ֣ב לָ֭אִישׁ לֶ֣חֶם שָׁ֑קֶר וְ֝אַחַ֗ר יִמָּֽלֵא פִ֥יהוּ חָצָֽץ׃
verses.en: Bread of falsehood is sweet to a man; but afterwards his mouth shall be filled with gravel.

verses.he: מַ֭חֲשָׁבוֹת בְּעֵצָ֣ה תִכּ֑וֹן וּ֝בְתַחְבֻּל֗וֹת עֲשֵׂ֣ה מִלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.en: Every purpose is established by counsel; and with good advice carry on war.

verses.he: גּֽוֹלֶה סּ֭וֹד הוֹלֵ֣ךְ רָכִ֑יל וּלְפֹתֶ֥ה שְׂ֝פָתָ֗יו לֹ֣א תִתְעָרָֽב׃
verses.en: He that goeth about as a talebearer revealeth secrets; therefore meddle not with him that openeth wide his lips.

verses.he: מְ֭קַלֵּל אָבִ֣יו וְאִמּ֑וֹ יִֽדְעַ֥ךְ נֵ֝ר֗וֹ באישוןבאישוןבֶּאֱשׁ֥וּןחֹֽשֶׁךְ׃
verses.en: Whoso curseth his father or his mother, his lamp shall be put out in the blackest darkness.

verses.he: נַ֭חֲלָה מבחלתמבחלתמְבֹהֶ֣לֶתבָּרִאשֹׁנָ֑ה וְ֝אַחֲרִיתָ֗הּ לֹ֣א תְבֹרָֽךְ׃
verses.en: An estate may be gotten hastily at the beginning; but the end thereof shall not be blessed.

verses.he: אַל תֹּאמַ֥ר אֲשַׁלְּמָה רָ֑ע קַוֵּ֥ה לַֽ֝יהוָ֗ה וְיֹ֣שַֽׁע לָֽךְ׃
verses.en: Say not thou: 'I will requite evil'; wait for HaShem, and He will save thee.

verses.he: תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה אֶ֣בֶן וָאָ֑בֶן וּמֹאזְנֵ֖י מִרְמָ֣ה לֹא טֽוֹב׃
verses.en: Divers weights are an abomination to HaShem; and a false balance is not good.

verses.he: מֵיהוָ֥ה מִצְעֲדֵי גָ֑בֶר וְ֝אָדָ֗ם מַה יָּבִ֥ין דַּרְכּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: A man's goings are of HaShem; how then can man look to his way?

verses.he: מוֹקֵ֣שׁ אָ֭דָם יָ֣לַע קֹ֑דֶשׁ וְאַחַ֖ר נְדָרִ֣ים לְבַקֵּֽר׃
verses.en: It is a snare to a man rashly to say: 'Holy', and after vows to make inquiry.

verses.he: מְזָרֶ֣ה רְ֭שָׁעִים מֶ֣לֶךְ חָכָ֑ם וַיָּ֖שֶׁב עֲלֵיהֶ֣ם אוֹפָֽן׃
verses.en: A wise king sifteth the wicked, and turneth the wheel over them.

verses.he: נֵ֣ר יְ֭הוָה נִשְׁמַ֣ת אָדָ֑ם חֹ֝פֵ֗שׂ כָּל חַדְרֵי בָֽטֶן׃
verses.en: The spirit of man is the lamp of HaShem, searching all the inward parts.

verses.he: חֶ֣סֶד וֶ֭אֱמֶת יִצְּרוּ מֶ֑לֶךְ וְסָעַ֖ד בַּחֶ֣סֶד כִּסְאֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Mercy and truth preserve the king; and his throne is upheld by mercy.

verses.he: תִּפְאֶ֣רֶת בַּחוּרִ֣ים כֹּחָ֑ם וַהֲדַ֖ר זְקֵנִ֣ים שֵׂיבָֽה׃
verses.en: The glory of young men is their strength; and the beauty of old men is the hoary head.

verses.he: חַבֻּר֣וֹת פֶּ֭צַע תמריקתמריקתַּמְר֣וּקבְּרָ֑ע וּ֝מַכּ֗וֹת חַדְרֵי בָֽטֶן׃
verses.en: Sharp wounds cleanse away evil; so do stripes that reach the inward parts.

verses.he: פַּלְגֵי מַ֣יִם לֶב מֶ֭לֶךְ בְּיַד יְהוָ֑ה עַֽל כָּל אֲשֶׁ֖ר יַחְפֹּ֣ץ יַטֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.en: The king's heart is in the hand of HaShem, as the watercourses: He turneth it whithersoever He will.

verses.he: כָּֽל דֶּרֶךְ אִ֭ישׁ יָשָׁ֣ר בְּעֵינָ֑יו וְתֹכֵ֖ן לִבּ֣וֹת יְהוָֽה׃
verses.en: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes; but HaShem weigheth the hearts.

verses.he: עֲ֭שֹׂה צְדָקָ֣ה וּמִשְׁפָּ֑ט נִבְחָ֖ר לַיהוָ֣ה מִזָּֽבַח׃
verses.en: To do righteousness and justice is more acceptable to HaShem than sacrifice.

verses.he: רוּם עֵ֭ינַיִם וּרְחַב לֵ֑ב נִ֖ר רְשָׁעִ֣ים חַטָּֽאת׃
verses.en: A haughty look, and a proud heart--the tillage of the wicked is sin.

verses.he: מַחְשְׁב֣וֹת חָ֭רוּץ אַךְ לְמוֹתָ֑ר וְכָל אָ֝֗ץ אַךְ לְמַחְסֽוֹר׃
verses.en: The thoughts of the diligent tend only to plenteousness; but every one that is hasty hasteth only to want.

verses.he: פֹּ֣עַל א֭וֹצָרוֹת בִּלְשׁ֣וֹן שָׁ֑קֶר הֶ֥בֶל נִ֝דָּ֗ף מְבַקְשֵׁי מָֽוֶת׃
verses.en: The getting of treasures by a lying tongue is a vapour driven to and fro; they that seek them seek death.

verses.he: שֹׁד רְשָׁעִ֥ים יְגוֹרֵ֑ם כִּ֥י מֵ֝אֲנ֗וּ לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת מִשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.en: The violence of the wicked shall drag them away; because they refuse to do justly.

verses.he: הֲפַכְפַּ֬ךְ דֶּ֣רֶךְ אִ֣ישׁ וָזָ֑ר וְ֝זַ֗ךְ יָשָׁ֥ר פָּעֳלֽוֹ׃
verses.en: The way of man is froward and strange; but as for the pure, his work is right.

verses.he: ט֗וֹב לָשֶׁ֥בֶת עַל פִּנַּת גָּ֑ג מֵאֵ֥שֶׁת מִ֝דְיָנִ֗ים וּבֵ֥ית חָֽבֶר׃
verses.en: It is better to dwell in a corner of the housetop, than in a house in common with a contentious woman.

verses.he: נֶ֣פֶשׁ רָ֭שָׁע אִוְּתָה רָ֑ע לֹא יֻחַ֖ן בְּעֵינָ֣יו רֵעֵֽהוּ׃
verses.en: The soul of the wicked desireth evil; his neighbour findeth no favour in his eyes.

verses.he: בַּעְנָשׁ לֵ֭ץ יֶחְכַּם פֶּ֑תִי וּבְהַשְׂכִּ֥יל לְ֝חָכָ֗ם יִקַּח דָּֽעַת׃
verses.en: When the scorner is punished, the thoughtless is made wise; and when the wise is instructed, he receiveth knowledge.

verses.he: מַשְׂכִּ֣יל צַ֭דִּיק לְבֵ֣ית רָשָׁ֑ע מְסַלֵּ֖ף רְשָׁעִ֣ים לָרָֽע׃
verses.en: The Righteous One considereth the house of the wicked; overthrowing the wicked to their ruin.

verses.he: אֹטֵ֣ם אָ֭זְנוֹ מִזַּעֲקַת דָּ֑ל גַּֽם ה֥וּא יִ֝קְרָ֗א וְלֹ֣א יֵעָנֶֽה׃
verses.en: Whoso stoppeth his ears at the cry of the poor, he also shall cry himself, but shall not be answered.

verses.he: מַתָּ֣ן בַּ֭סֵּתֶר יִכְפֶּה אָ֑ף וְשֹׁ֥חַד בַּ֝חֵ֗ק חֵמָ֥ה עַזָּֽה׃
verses.en: A gift in secret pacifieth anger, and a present in the bosom strong wrath.

verses.he: שִׂמְחָ֣ה לַ֭צַּדִּיק עֲשׂ֣וֹת מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וּ֝מְחִתָּ֗ה לְפֹ֣עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃
verses.en: To do justly is joy to the righteous, but ruin to the workers of iniquity.

verses.he: אָדָ֗ם תּ֭וֹעֶה מִדֶּ֣רֶךְ הַשְׂכֵּ֑ל בִּקְהַ֖ל רְפָאִ֣ים יָנֽוּחַ׃
verses.en: The man that strayeth out of the way of understanding shall rest in the congregation of the shades.

verses.he: אִ֣ישׁ מַ֭חְסוֹר אֹהֵ֣ב שִׂמְחָ֑ה אֹהֵ֥ב יַֽיִן וָ֝שֶׁ֗מֶן לֹ֣א יַעֲשִֽׁיר׃
verses.en: He that loveth pleasure shall be a poor man; he that loveth wine and oil shall not be rich.

verses.he: כֹּ֣פֶר לַצַּדִּ֣יק רָשָׁ֑ע וְתַ֖חַת יְשָׁרִ֣ים בּוֹגֵֽד׃
verses.en: The wicked is a ransom for the righteous; and the faithless cometh in the stead of the upright.

verses.he: ט֗וֹב שֶׁ֥בֶת בְּאֶֽרֶץ מִדְבָּ֑ר מֵאֵ֖שֶׁת מדוניםמדוניםמִדְיָנִ֣יםוָכָֽעַס׃
verses.en: It is better to dwell in a desert land, than with a contentious and fretful woman.

verses.he: אוֹצָ֤ר נֶחְמָ֣ד וָ֭שֶׁמֶן בִּנְוֵ֣ה חָכָ֑ם וּכְסִ֖יל אָדָ֣ם יְבַלְּעֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.en: There is desirable treasure and oil in the dwelling of the wise; but a foolish man swalloweth it up.

verses.he: רֹ֭דֵף צְדָקָ֣ה וָחָ֑סֶד יִמְצָ֥א חַ֝יִּ֗ים צְדָקָ֥ה וְכָבֽוֹד׃
verses.en: He that followeth after righteousness and mercy findeth life, prosperity, and honour.

verses.he: עִ֣יר גִּ֭בֹּרִים עָלָ֣ה חָכָ֑ם וַ֝יֹּ֗רֶד עֹ֣ז מִבְטֶחָֽה׃
verses.en: A wise man scaleth the city of the mighty, and bringeth down the stronghold wherein it trusteth.

verses.he: שֹׁמֵ֣ר פִּ֭יו וּלְשׁוֹנ֑וֹ שֹׁמֵ֖ר מִצָּר֣וֹת נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.en: Whoso keepeth his mouth and his tongue keepeth his soul from troubles.

verses.he: זֵ֣ד יָ֭הִיר לֵ֣ץ שְׁמ֑וֹ ע֝וֹשֶׂ֗ה בְּעֶבְרַ֥ת זָדֽוֹן׃
verses.en: A proud and haughty man, scorner is his name, even he that dealeth in overbearing pride.

verses.he: תַּאֲוַ֣ת עָצֵ֣ל תְּמִיתֶ֑נּוּ כִּֽי מֵאֲנ֖וּ יָדָ֣יו לַעֲשֽׂוֹת׃
verses.en: The desire of the slothful killeth him; for his hands refuse to labour.

verses.he: כָּל הַ֭יּוֹם הִתְאַוָּ֣ה תַאֲוָ֑ה וְצַדִּ֥יק יִ֝תֵּ֗ן וְלֹ֣א יַחְשֹֽׂךְ׃
verses.en: There is that coveteth greedily all the day long; but the righteous giveth and spareth not.

verses.he: זֶ֣בַח רְ֭שָׁעִים תּוֹעֵבָ֑ה אַ֝֗ף כִּֽי בְזִמָּ֥ה יְבִיאֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.en: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination; how much more, when he bringeth it with the proceeds of wickedness?

verses.he: עֵד כְּזָבִ֥ים יֹאבֵ֑ד וְאִ֥ישׁ שׁ֝וֹמֵ֗עַ לָנֶ֥צַח יְדַבֵּֽר׃
verses.en: A false witness shall perish; but the man that obeyeth shall speak unchallenged.

verses.he: הֵעֵ֬ז אִ֣ישׁ רָשָׁ֣ע בְּפָנָ֑יו וְ֝יָשָׁ֗ר ה֤וּא יכיןיכיןיָבִ֬יןדרכיודרכיודַּרְכּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: A wicked man hardeneth his face; but as for the upright, he looketh well to his way.

verses.he: אֵ֣ין חָ֭כְמָה וְאֵ֣ין תְּבוּנָ֑ה וְאֵ֥ין עֵ֝צָ֗ה לְנֶ֣גֶד יְהוָֽה׃ פ
verses.en: There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against HaShem.

verses.he: ס֗וּס מ֭וּכָן לְי֣וֹם מִלְחָמָ֑ה וְ֝לַֽיהוָ֗ה הַתְּשׁוּעָֽה׃
verses.en: The horse is prepared against the day of battle; but victory is of HaShem.

verses.he: נִבְחָ֣ר שֵׁ֭ם מֵעֹ֣שֶׁר רָ֑ב מִכֶּ֥סֶף וּ֝מִזָּהָ֗ב חֵ֣ן טֽוֹב׃
verses.en: A good name is rather to be chosen than great riches, and loving favour rather than silver and gold.

verses.he: עָשִׁ֣יר וָרָ֣שׁ נִפְגָּ֑שׁוּ עֹשֵׂ֖ה כֻלָּ֣ם יְהוָֽה׃
verses.en: The rich and the poor meet together--the HaShem is the maker of them all.

verses.he: עָר֤וּם רָאָ֣ה רָעָ֣ה ויסתרויסתרוְנִסְתָּ֑רוּ֝פְתָיִ֗ים עָבְר֥וּ וְֽנֶעֱנָֽשׁוּ׃
verses.en: A prudent man seeth the evil, and hideth himself; but the thoughtless pass on, and are punished.

verses.he: עֵ֣קֶב עֲ֭נָוָה יִרְאַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה עֹ֖שֶׁר וְכָב֣וֹד וְחַיִּֽים׃
verses.en: The reward of humility is the fear of HaShem, even riches, and honour, and life.

verses.he: צִנִּ֣ים פַּ֭חִים בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ עִקֵּ֑שׁ שׁוֹמֵ֥ר נַ֝פְשׁ֗וֹ יִרְחַ֥ק מֵהֶֽם׃
verses.en: Thorns and snares are in the way of the froward; he that keepeth his soul holdeth himself far from them.

verses.he: חֲנֹ֣ךְ לַ֭נַּעַר עַל פִּ֣י דַרְכּ֑וֹ גַּ֥ם כִּֽי יַ֝זְקִ֗ין לֹֽא יָס֥וּר מִמֶּֽנָּה׃
verses.en: Train up a child in the way he should go, and even when he is old, he will not depart from it.

verses.he: עָ֭שִׁיר בְּרָשִׁ֣ים יִמְשׁ֑וֹל וְעֶ֥בֶד לֹ֝וֶ֗ה לְאִ֣ישׁ מַלְוֶֽה׃
verses.en: The rich ruleth over the poor, and the borrower is servant to the lender.

verses.he: זוֹרֵ֣עַ עַ֭וְלָה יקצוריקצוריִקְצָר אָ֑וֶן וְשֵׁ֖בֶט עֶבְרָת֣וֹ יִכְלֶֽה׃
verses.en: He that soweth iniquity shall reap vanity; and the rod of his wrath shall fail.

verses.he: טֽוֹב עַ֭יִן ה֣וּא יְבֹרָ֑ךְ כִּֽי נָתַ֖ן מִלַּחְמ֣וֹ לַדָּֽל׃
verses.en: He that hath a bountiful eye shall be blessed; for he giveth of his bread to the poor.

verses.he: גָּ֣רֵֽשׁ לֵ֭ץ וְיֵצֵ֣א מָד֑וֹן וְ֝יִשְׁבֹּ֗ת דִּ֣ין וְקָלֽוֹן׃
verses.en: Cast out the scorner, and contention will go out; yea, strife and shame will cease.

verses.he: אֹהֵ֥ב טהורטהורטְהָר לֵ֑ב חֵ֥ן שְׂ֝פָתָ֗יו רֵעֵ֥הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ׃
verses.en: He that loveth pureness of heart, that hath grace in his lips, the king shall be his friend.

verses.he: עֵינֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה נָ֣צְרוּ דָ֑עַת וַ֝יְסַלֵּ֗ף דִּבְרֵ֥י בֹגֵֽד׃
verses.en: The eyes of HaShem preserve him that hath knowledge, but He overthroweth the words of the faithless man.

verses.he: אָמַ֣ר עָ֭צֵל אֲרִ֣י בַח֑וּץ בְּת֥וֹךְ רְ֝חֹב֗וֹת אֵֽרָצֵֽחַ׃
verses.en: The sluggard saith: 'There is a lion without; I shall be slain in the streets.'

verses.he: שׁוּחָ֣ה עֲ֭מֻקָּה פִּ֣י זָר֑וֹת זְע֥וּם יְ֝הוָ֗ה יפוליפוליִפָּל שָֽׁם׃
verses.en: The mouth of strange women is a deep pit: he that is abhorred of HaShem shall fall therein.

verses.he: אִ֭וֶּלֶת קְשׁוּרָ֣ה בְלֶב נָ֑עַר שֵׁ֥בֶט מ֝וּסָ֗ר יַרְחִיקֶ֥נָּה מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.en: Foolishness is bound up in the heart of a child; but the rod of correction shall drive it far from him.

verses.he: עֹ֣שֵֽׁק דָּ֭ל לְהַרְבּ֣וֹת ל֑וֹ נֹתֵ֥ן לְ֝עָשִׁ֗יר אַךְ לְמַחְסֽוֹר׃
verses.en: One may oppress the poor, yet will their gain increase; one may give to the rich, yet will want come.

verses.he: הַ֥ט אָזְנְךָ֗ וּ֭שְׁמַע דִּבְרֵ֣י חֲכָמִ֑ים וְ֝לִבְּךָ֗ תָּשִׁ֥ית לְדַעְתִּֽי׃
verses.en: Incline thine ear, and hear the words of the wise, and apply thy heart unto my knowledge.

verses.he: כִּֽי נָ֭עִים כִּֽי תִשְׁמְרֵ֣ם בְּבִטְנֶ֑ךָ יִכֹּ֥נוּ יַ֝חְדָּ֗ו עַל שְׂפָתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.en: For it is a pleasant thing if thou keep them within thee; let them be established altogether upon thy lips.

verses.he: לִהְי֣וֹת בַּ֭יהוָה מִבְטַחֶ֑ךָ הוֹדַעְתִּ֖יךָ הַיּ֣וֹם אַף אָֽתָּה׃
verses.en: That thy trust may be in HaShem, I have made them known to thee this day, even to thee.

verses.he: הֲלֹ֤א כָתַ֣בְתִּי לְ֭ךָ שלשוםשלשוםשָׁלִישִׁ֑יםבְּמ֖וֹעֵצֹ֣ת וָדָֽעַת׃
verses.en: Have not I written unto thee excellent things of counsels and knowledge;

verses.he: לְהוֹדִֽיעֲךָ֗ קֹ֭שְׁטְ אִמְרֵ֣י אֱמֶ֑ת לְהָשִׁ֥יב אֲמָרִ֥ים אֱ֝מֶ֗ת לְשֹׁלְחֶֽיךָ׃ פ
verses.en: That I might make thee know the certainty of the words of truth, that thou mightest bring back words of truth to them that send thee?

verses.he: אַֽל תִּגְזָל דָּ֭ל כִּ֣י דַל ה֑וּא וְאַל תְּדַכֵּ֖א עָנִ֣י בַשָּֽׁעַר׃
verses.en: Rob not the weak, because he is weak, neither crush the poor in the gate;

verses.he: כִּֽי יְ֭הוָה יָרִ֣יב רִיבָ֑ם וְקָבַ֖ע אֶת קֹבְעֵיהֶ֣ם נָֽפֶשׁ׃
verses.en: For HaShem will plead their cause, and despoil of life those that despoil them.

verses.he: אַל תִּ֭תְרַע אֶת בַּ֣עַל אָ֑ף וְאֶת אִ֥ישׁ חֵ֝מוֹת לֹ֣א תָבֽוֹא׃
verses.en: Make no friendship with a man that is given to anger; and with a wrathful man thou shalt not go;

verses.he: פֶּן תֶּאֱלַ֥ף ארחתוארחתואֹֽרְחֹתָ֑יווְלָקַחְתָּ֖ מוֹקֵ֣שׁ לְנַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃
verses.en: Lest thou learn his ways, and get a snare to thy soul.

verses.he: אַל תְּהִ֥י בְתֹֽקְעֵי כָ֑ף בַּ֝עֹרְבִ֗ים מַשָּׁאֽוֹת׃
verses.en: Be thou not of them that strike hands, or of them that are sureties for debts;

verses.he: אִם אֵֽין לְךָ֥ לְשַׁלֵּ֑ם לָ֥מָּה יִקַּ֥ח מִ֝שְׁכָּבְךָ֗ מִתַּחְתֶּֽיךָ׃
verses.en: If thou hast not wherewith to pay, why should he take away thy bed from under thee?

verses.he: אַל תַּ֭סֵּג גְּב֣וּל עוֹלָ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר עָשׂ֣וּ אֲבוֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.en: Remove not the ancient landmark, which thy fathers have set.

verses.he: חָזִ֡יתָ אִ֤ישׁ מָ֘הִ֤יר בִּמְלַאכְתּ֗וֹ לִֽפְנֵֽי מְלָכִ֥ים יִתְיַצָּ֑ב בַּל יִ֝תְיַצֵּב לִפְנֵ֥י חֲשֻׁכִּֽים׃ פ
verses.en: Seest thou a man diligent in his business? he shall stand before kings; he shall not stand before mean men.

verses.he: כִּֽי תֵ֭שֵׁב לִלְח֣וֹם אֶת מוֹשֵׁ֑ל בִּ֥ין תָּ֝בִ֗ין אֶת אֲשֶׁ֥ר לְפָנֶֽיךָ׃
verses.en: When thou sittest to eat with a ruler, consider well him that is before thee;

verses.he: וְשַׂמְתָּ֣ שַׂכִּ֣ין בְּלֹעֶ֑ךָ אִם בַּ֖עַל נֶ֣פֶשׁ אָֽתָּה׃
verses.en: And put a knife to thy throat, if thou be a man given to appetite.

verses.he: אַל תִּ֭תְאָו לְמַטְעַמּוֹתָ֑יו וְ֝ה֗וּא לֶ֣חֶם כְּזָבִֽים׃
verses.en: Be not desirous of his dainties; seeing they are deceitful food.

verses.he: אַל תִּיגַ֥ע לְֽהַעֲשִׁ֑יר מִֽבִּינָתְךָ֥ חֲדָֽל׃
verses.en: Weary not thyself to be rich; cease from thine own wisdom.

verses.he: התעוףהתעוףהֲתָ֤עִיףעֵינֶ֥יךָ בּ֗וֹ וְֽאֵ֫ינֶ֥נּוּ כִּ֤י עָשֹׂ֣ה יַעֲשֶׂה לּ֣וֹ כְנָפַ֑יִם כְּ֝נֶ֗שֶׁר ועיףועיףיָע֥וּףהַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃ פ
verses.en: Wilt thou set thine eyes upon it? it is gone; for riches certainly make themselves wings, like an eagle that flieth toward heaven.

verses.he: אַל תִּלְחַ֗ם אֶת לֶ֭חֶם רַ֣ע עָ֑יִן וְאַל תתאותתאותִּ֝תְאָ֗יולְמַטְעַמֹּתָֽיו׃
verses.en: Eat thou not the bread of him that hath an evil eye, neither desire thou his dainties;

verses.he: כִּ֤י כְּמוֹ שָׁעַ֥ר בְּנַפְשׁ֗וֹ כֶּ֫ן ה֥וּא אֱכֹ֣ל וּ֭שְׁתֵה יֹ֣אמַר לָ֑ךְ וְ֝לִבּ֗וֹ בַּל עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.en: For as one that hath reckoned within himself, so is he: 'Eat and drink', saith he to thee; but his heart is not with thee.

verses.he: פִּֽתְּךָ אָכַ֥לְתָּ תְקִיאֶ֑נָּה וְ֝שִׁחַ֗תָּ דְּבָרֶ֥יךָ הַנְּעִימִֽים׃
verses.en: The morsel which thou hast eaten shalt thou vomit up, and lose thy sweet words.

verses.he: בְּאָזְנֵ֣י כְ֭סִיל אַל תְּדַבֵּ֑ר כִּֽי יָ֝ב֗וּז לְשֵׂ֣כֶל מִלֶּֽיךָ׃
verses.en: Speak not in the ears of a fool; for he will despise the wisdom of thy words.

verses.he: אַל תַּ֭סֵּג גְּב֣וּל עוֹלָ֑ם וּבִשְׂדֵ֥י יְ֝תוֹמִ֗ים אַל תָּבֹֽא׃
verses.en: Remove not the ancient landmark; and enter not into the fields of the fatherless;

verses.he: כִּֽי גֹאֲלָ֥ם חָזָ֑ק הֽוּא יָרִ֖יב אֶת רִיבָ֣ם אִתָּֽךְ׃
verses.en: For their Redeemer is strong; He will plead their cause with thee.

verses.he: הָבִ֣יאָה לַמּוּסָ֣ר לִבֶּ֑ךָ וְ֝אָזְנֶ֗ךָ לְאִמְרֵי דָֽעַת׃
verses.en: Apply thy heart unto instruction, and thine ears to the words of knowledge.

verses.he: אַל תִּמְנַ֣ע מִנַּ֣עַר מוּסָ֑ר כִּֽי תַכֶּ֥נּוּ בַ֝שֵּׁ֗בֶט לֹ֣א יָמֽוּת׃
verses.en: Withhold not correction from the child; for though thou beat him with the rod, he will not die.

verses.he: אַ֭תָּה בַּשֵּׁ֣בֶט תַּכֶּ֑נּוּ וְ֝נַפְשׁ֗וֹ מִשְּׁא֥וֹל תַּצִּֽיל׃
verses.en: Thou beatest him with the rod, and wilt deliver his soul from the nether-world.

verses.he: בְּ֭נִי אִם חָכַ֣ם לִבֶּ֑ךָ יִשְׂמַ֖ח לִבִּ֣י גַם אָֽנִי׃
verses.en: My son, if thy heart be wise, my heart will be glad, even mine;

verses.he: וְתַעְלֹ֥זְנָה כִלְיוֹתָ֑י בְּדַבֵּ֥ר שְׂ֝פָתֶ֗יךָ מֵישָׁרִֽים׃
verses.en: Yea, my reins will rejoice, when thy lips speak right things.

verses.he: אַל יְקַנֵּ֣א לִ֭בְּךָ בַּֽחַטָּאִ֑ים כִּ֥י אִם בְּיִרְאַת יְ֝הוָ֗ה כָּל הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.en: Let not thy heart envy sinners, but be in the fear of HaShem all the day;

verses.he: כִּ֭י אִם יֵ֣שׁ אַחֲרִ֑ית וְ֝תִקְוָתְךָ֗ לֹ֣א תִכָּרֵֽת׃
verses.en: For surely there is a future; and thy hope shall not be cut off.

verses.he: שְׁמַע אַתָּ֣ה בְנִ֣י וַחֲכָ֑ם וְאַשֵּׁ֖ר בַּדֶּ֣רֶךְ לִבֶּֽךָ׃
verses.en: Hear thou, my son, and be wise, and guide thy heart in the way.

verses.he: אַל תְּהִ֥י בְסֹֽבְאֵי יָ֑יִן בְּזֹלֲלֵ֖י בָשָׂ֣ר לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.en: Be not among winebibbers; among gluttonous eaters of flesh;

verses.he: כִּי סֹבֵ֣א וְ֭זוֹלֵל יִוָּרֵ֑שׁ וּ֝קְרָעִ֗ים תַּלְבִּ֥ישׁ נוּמָֽה׃
verses.en: For the drunkard and the glutton shall come to poverty; and drowsiness shall clothe a man with rags.

verses.he: שְׁמַ֣ע לְ֭אָבִיךָ זֶ֣ה יְלָדֶ֑ךָ וְאַל תָּ֝ב֗וּז כִּֽי זָקְנָ֥ה אִמֶּֽךָ׃
verses.en: Hearken unto thy father that begot thee, and despise not thy mother when she is old.

verses.he: אֱמֶ֣ת קְ֭נֵה וְאַל תִּמְכֹּ֑ר חָכְמָ֖ה וּמוּסָ֣ר וּבִינָֽה׃
verses.en: Buy the truth, and sell it not; also wisdom, and instruction, and understanding.

verses.he: גולגולגִּ֣יליגוליגוליָ֭גִילאֲבִ֣י צַדִּ֑יק יולדיולדוְיוֹלֵ֥דחָ֝כָ֗ם וישמחוישמחיִשְׂמַח בּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: The father of the righteous will greatly rejoice; and he that begetteth a wise child will have joy of him.

verses.he: יִֽשְׂמַח אָבִ֥יךָ וְאִמֶּ֑ךָ וְ֝תָגֵ֗ל יֽוֹלַדְתֶּֽךָ׃
verses.en: Let thy father and thy mother be glad, and let her that bore thee rejoice.

verses.he: תְּנָֽה בְנִ֣י לִבְּךָ֣ לִ֑י וְ֝עֵינֶ֗יךָ דְּרָכַ֥י תרצנהתרצנהתִּצֹּֽרְנָה׃
verses.en: My son, give me thy heart, and let thine eyes observe my ways.

verses.he: כִּֽי שׁוּחָ֣ה עֲמֻקָּ֣ה זוֹנָ֑ה וּבְאֵ֥ר צָ֝רָ֗ה נָכְרִיָּֽה׃
verses.en: For a harlot is a deep ditch; and an alien woman is a narrow pit.

verses.he: אַף הִ֭יא כְּחֶ֣תֶף תֶּֽאֱרֹ֑ב וּ֝בוֹגְדִ֗ים בְּאָדָ֥ם תּוֹסִֽף׃
verses.en: She also lieth in wait as a robber, and increaseth the faithless among men.

verses.he: לְמִ֨י א֥וֹי לְמִ֪י אֲב֡וֹי לְמִ֤י מדוניםמדוניםמִדְיָנִ֨ים לְמִ֥י שִׂ֗יחַ לְ֭מִי פְּצָעִ֣ים חִנָּ֑ם לְ֝מִ֗י חַכְלִל֥וּת עֵינָֽיִם׃
verses.en: Who crieth: 'Woe'? who: 'Alas'? Who hath contentions? who hath raving? who hath wounds without cause? who hath redness of eyes?

verses.he: לַֽמְאַחֲרִ֥ים עַל הַיָּ֑יִן לַ֝בָּאִ֗ים לַחְקֹ֥ר מִמְסָֽךְ׃
verses.en: They that tarry long at the wine; they that go to try mixed wine.

verses.he: אַל תֵּ֥רֶא יַיִן֮ כִּ֪י יִתְאַ֫דָּ֥ם כִּֽי יִתֵּ֣ן בכיסבכיסבַּכּ֣וֹסעֵינ֑וֹ יִ֝תְהַלֵּ֗ךְ בְּמֵישָׁרִֽים׃
verses.en: Look not thou upon the wine when it is red, when it giveth its colour in the cup, when it glideth down smoothly;

verses.he: אַ֭חֲרִיתוֹ כְּנָחָ֣שׁ יִשָּׁ֑ךְ וּֽכְצִפְעֹנִ֥י יַפְרִֽשׁ׃
verses.en: At the last it biteth like a serpent, and stingeth like a basilisk.

verses.he: עֵ֭ינֶיךָ יִרְא֣וּ זָר֑וֹת וְ֝לִבְּךָ֗ יְדַבֵּ֥ר תַּהְפֻּכֽוֹת׃
verses.en: Thine eyes shall behold strange things, and thy heart shall utter confused things.

verses.he: וְ֭הָיִיתָ כְּשֹׁכֵ֣ב בְּלֶב יָ֑ם וּ֝כְשֹׁכֵ֗ב בְּרֹ֣אשׁ חִבֵּֽל׃
verses.en: Yea, thou shalt be as he that lieth down in the midst of the sea, or as he that lieth upon the top of a mast.

verses.he: הִכּ֥וּנִי בַל חָלִיתִי֮ הֲלָמ֗וּנִי בַּל יָ֫דָ֥עְתִּי מָתַ֥י אָקִ֑יץ א֝וֹסִ֗יף אֲבַקְשֶׁ֥נּוּ עֽוֹד׃
verses.en: 'They have struck me, and I felt it not, they have beaten me, and I knew it not; when shall I awake? I will seek it yet again.'

verses.he: אַל תְּ֭קַנֵּא בְּאַנְשֵׁ֣י רָעָ֑ה וְאַל תתאותתאותִּ֝תְאָ֗יולִהְי֥וֹת אִתָּֽם׃
verses.en: Be not thou envious of evil men, neither desire to be with them.

verses.he: כִּי שֹׁ֭ד יֶהְגֶּ֣ה לִבָּ֑ם וְ֝עָמָ֗ל שִׂפְתֵיהֶ֥ם תְּדַבֵּֽרְנָה׃
verses.en: For their heart studieth destruction, and their lips talk of mischief.

verses.he: בְּ֭חָכְמָה יִבָּ֣נֶה בָּ֑יִת וּ֝בִתְבוּנָ֗ה יִתְכּוֹנָֽן׃
verses.en: Through wisdom is a house builded; and by understanding it is established;

verses.he: וּ֭בְדַעַת חֲדָרִ֣ים יִמָּלְא֑וּ כָּל ה֖וֹן יָקָ֣ר וְנָעִֽים׃
verses.en: And by knowledge are the chambers filled with all precious and pleasant riches.

verses.he: גֶּֽבֶר חָכָ֥ם בַּע֑וֹז וְאִֽישׁ דַּ֝֗עַת מְאַמֶּץ כֹּֽחַ׃
verses.en: A wise man is strong; yea, a man of knowledge increaseth strength.

verses.he: כִּ֣י בְ֭תַחְבֻּלוֹת תַּעֲשֶׂה לְּךָ֣ מִלְחָמָ֑ה וּ֝תְשׁוּעָ֗ה בְּרֹ֣ב יוֹעֵֽץ׃
verses.en: For with wise advice thou shalt make thy war; and in the multitude of counsellors there is safety.

verses.he: רָאמ֣וֹת לֶֽאֱוִ֣יל חָכְמ֑וֹת בַּ֝שַּׁ֗עַר לֹ֣א יִפְתַּח פִּֽיהוּ׃
verses.en: Wisdom is as unattainable to a fool as corals; he openeth not his mouth in the gate.

verses.he: מְחַשֵּׁ֥ב לְהָרֵ֑עַ ל֝֗וֹ בַּֽעַל מְזִמּ֥וֹת יִקְרָֽאוּ׃
verses.en: He that deviseth to do evil, men shall call him a mischievous person.

verses.he: זִמַּ֣ת אִוֶּ֣לֶת חַטָּ֑את וְתוֹעֲבַ֖ת לְאָדָ֣ם לֵֽץ׃
verses.en: The thought of foolishness is sin; and the scorner is an abomination to men.

verses.he: הִ֭תְרַפִּיתָ בְּי֥וֹם צָרָ֗ה צַ֣ר כֹּחֶֽכָה׃
verses.en: If thou faint in the day of adversity, thy strength is small indeed.

verses.he: הַ֭צֵּל לְקֻחִ֣ים לַמָּ֑וֶת וּמָטִ֥ים לַ֝הֶ֗רֶג אִם תַּחְשֽׂוֹךְ׃
verses.en: Deliver them that are drawn unto death; and those that are ready to be slain wilt thou forbear to rescue?

verses.he: כִּֽי תֹאמַ֗ר הֵן֮ לֹא יָדַ֪עְנ֫וּ זֶ֥ה הֲֽלֹא תֹ֘כֵ֤ן לִבּ֨וֹת הֽוּא יָבִ֗ין וְנֹצֵ֣ר נַ֭פְשְׁךָ ה֣וּא יֵדָ֑ע וְהֵשִׁ֖יב לְאָדָ֣ם כְּפָעֳלֽוֹ׃
verses.en: If thou sayest: 'Behold, we knew not this', doth not He that weigheth the hearts consider it? And He that keepeth thy soul, doth not He know it? And shall not He render to every man according to his works?

verses.he: אֱכָל בְּנִ֣י דְבַ֣שׁ כִּי ט֑וֹב וְנֹ֥פֶת מָ֝ת֗וֹק עַל חִכֶּֽךָ׃
verses.en: My son, eat thou honey, for it is good, and the honeycomb is sweet to thy taste;

verses.he: כֵּ֤ן דְּעֶ֥ה חָכְמָ֗ה לְנַ֫פְשֶׁ֥ךָ אִם מָ֭צָאתָ וְיֵ֣שׁ אַחֲרִ֑ית וְ֝תִקְוָתְךָ֗ לֹ֣א תִכָּרֵֽת׃ פ
verses.en: So know thou wisdom to be unto thy soul; if thou hast found it, then shall there be a future, and thy hope shall not be cut off.

verses.he: אַל תֶּאֱרֹ֣ב רָ֭שָׁע לִנְוֵ֣ה צַדִּ֑יק אַֽל תְּשַׁדֵּ֥ד רִבְצוֹ׃
verses.en: Lie not in wait, O wicked man, against the dwelling of the righteous, spoil not his resting-place;

verses.he: כִּ֤י שֶׁ֨בַע יִפּ֣וֹל צַדִּ֣יק וָקָ֑ם וּ֝רְשָׁעִ֗ים יִכָּשְׁל֥וּ בְרָעָֽה׃
verses.en: For a righteous man falleth seven times, and riseth up again, but the wicked stumble under adversity.

verses.he: בִּנְפֹ֣ל אויביךאויביךאֽ֭וֹיִבְךָאַל תִּשְׂמָ֑ח וּ֝בִכָּשְׁל֗וֹ אַל יָגֵ֥ל לִבֶּֽךָ׃
verses.en: Rejoice not when thine enemy falleth, and let not thy heart be glad when he stumbleth;

verses.he: פֶּן יִרְאֶ֣ה יְ֭הוָה וְרַ֣ע בְּעֵינָ֑יו וְהֵשִׁ֖יב מֵעָלָ֣יו אַפּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Lest HaShem see it, and it displease Him, and He turn away His wrath from him.

verses.he: אַל תִּתְחַ֥ר בַּמְּרֵעִ֑ים אַל תְּ֝קַנֵּ֗א בָּרְשָׁעִֽים׃
verses.en: Fret not thyself because of evildoers, neither be thou envious at the wicked;

verses.he: כִּ֤י לֹֽא תִהְיֶ֣ה אַחֲרִ֣ית לָרָ֑ע נֵ֖ר רְשָׁעִ֣ים יִדְעָֽךְ׃
verses.en: For there will be no future to the evil man, the lamp of the wicked shall be put out.

verses.he: יְרָֽא אֶת יְהוָ֣ה בְּנִ֣י וָמֶ֑לֶךְ עִם שׁ֝וֹנִ֗ים אַל תִּתְעָרָֽב׃
verses.en: My son, fear thou HaShem and the king, and meddle not with them that are given to change;

verses.he: כִּֽי פִ֭תְאֹם יָק֣וּם אֵידָ֑ם וּפִ֥יד שְׁ֝נֵיהֶ֗ם מִ֣י יוֹדֵֽעַ׃ ס
verses.en: For their calamity shall rise suddenly; and who knoweth the ruin from them both?

verses.he: גַּם אֵ֥לֶּה לַֽחֲכָמִ֑ים הַֽכֵּר פָּנִ֖ים בְּמִשְׁפָּ֣ט בַּל טֽוֹב׃
verses.en: These also are sayings of the wise. To have respect of persons in judgment is not good.

verses.he: אֹ֤מֵ֨ר לְרָשָׁע֮ צַדִּ֪יק אָ֥תָּה יִקְּבֻ֥הוּ עַמִּ֑ים יִזְעָמ֥וּהוּ לְאֻמִּֽים׃
verses.en: He that saith unto the wicked: 'Thou art righteous', peoples shall curse him, nations shall execrate him;

verses.he: וְלַמּוֹכִיחִ֥ים יִנְעָ֑ם וַֽ֝עֲלֵיהֶ֗ם תָּב֥וֹא בִרְכַּת טֽוֹב׃
verses.en: But to them that decide justly shall be delight, and a good blessing shall come upon them.

verses.he: שְׂפָתַ֥יִם יִשָּׁ֑ק מֵ֝שִׁ֗יב דְּבָרִ֥ים נְכֹחִֽים׃
verses.en: He kisseth the lips that giveth a right answer.

verses.he: הָ֘כֵ֤ן בַּח֨וּץ מְלַאכְתֶּ֗ךָ וְעַתְּדָ֣הּ בַּשָּׂדֶ֣ה לָ֑ךְ אַ֝חַ֗ר וּבָנִ֥יתָ בֵיתֶֽךָ׃ פ
verses.en: Prepare thy work without, and make it fit for thyself in the field; and afterwards build thy house.

verses.he: אַל תְּהִ֣י עֵד חִנָּ֣ם בְּרֵעֶ֑ךָ וַ֝הֲפִתִּ֗יתָ בִּשְׂפָתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.en: Be not a witness against thy neighbour without cause; and deceive not with thy lips.

verses.he: אַל תֹּאמַ֗ר כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר עָֽשָׂה לִ֭י כֵּ֤ן אֶֽעֱשֶׂה לּ֑וֹ אָשִׁ֖יב לָאִ֣ישׁ כְּפָעֳלֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Say not: 'I will do so to him as he hath done to me; I will render to the man according to his work.'

verses.he: עַל שְׂדֵ֣ה אִישׁ עָצֵ֣ל עָבַ֑רְתִּי וְעַל כֶּ֝֗רֶם אָדָ֥ם חֲסַר לֵֽב׃
verses.en: I went by the field of the slothful, and by the vineyard of the man void of understanding;

verses.he: וְהִנֵּ֨ה עָ֘לָ֤ה כֻלּ֨וֹ קִמְּשֹׂנִ֗ים כָּסּ֣וּ פָנָ֣יו חֲרֻלִּ֑ים וְגֶ֖דֶר אֲבָנָ֣יו נֶהֱרָֽסָה׃
verses.en: And, lo, it was all grown over with thistles, the face thereof was covered with nettles, and the stone wall thereof was broken down.

verses.he: וָֽאֶחֱזֶ֣ה אָ֭נֹכִֽי אָשִׁ֣ית לִבִּ֑י רָ֝אִ֗יתִי לָקַ֥חְתִּי מוּסָֽר׃
verses.en: Then I beheld, and considered well; I saw, and received instruction.

verses.he: מְעַ֣ט שֵׁ֭נוֹת מְעַ֣ט תְּנוּמ֑וֹת מְעַ֓ט חִבֻּ֖ק יָדַ֣יִם לִשְׁכָּֽב׃
verses.en: 'Yet a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep'--

verses.he: וּבָֽא מִתְהַלֵּ֥ךְ רֵישֶׁ֑ךָ וּ֝מַחְסֹרֶ֗יךָ כְּאִ֣ישׁ מָגֵֽן׃ פ
verses.en: So shall thy poverty come as a runner, and thy want as an armed man.

verses.he: גַּם אֵ֭לֶּה מִשְׁלֵ֣י שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶ֝עְתִּ֗יקוּ אַנְשֵׁ֤י חִזְקִיָּ֬ה מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.en: These also are proverbs of Solomon, which the men of Hezekiah king of Judah copied out.

verses.he: כְּבֹ֣ד אֱ֭לֹהִים הַסְתֵּ֣ר דָּבָ֑ר וּכְבֹ֥ד מְ֝לָכִ֗ים חֲקֹ֣ר דָּבָֽר׃
verses.en: It is the glory of G-d to conceal a thing; but the glory of kings is to search out a matter.

verses.he: שָׁמַ֣יִם לָ֭רוּם וָאָ֣רֶץ לָעֹ֑מֶק וְלֵ֥ב מְ֝לָכִ֗ים אֵ֣ין חֵֽקֶר׃
verses.en: The heaven for height, and the earth for depth, and the heart of kings is unsearchable.

verses.he: הָג֣וֹ סִיגִ֣ים מִכָּ֑סֶף וַיֵּצֵ֖א לַצֹּרֵ֣ף כֶּֽלִי׃
verses.en: Take away the dross from the silver, and there cometh forth a vessel for the refiner;

verses.he: הָג֣וֹ רָ֭שָׁע לִפְנֵי מֶ֑לֶךְ וְיִכּ֖וֹן בַּצֶּ֣דֶק כִּסְאֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Take away the wicked from before the king, and his throne shall be established in righteousness.

verses.he: אַל תִּתְהַדַּ֥ר לִפְנֵי מֶ֑לֶךְ וּבִמְק֥וֹם גְּ֝דֹלִ֗ים אַֽל תַּעֲמֹֽד׃
verses.en: Glorify not thyself in the presence of the king, and stand not in the place of great men;

verses.he: כִּ֤י ט֥וֹב אֲמָר לְךָ֗ עֲֽלֵ֫ה הֵ֥נָּה מֵֽ֭הַשְׁפִּ֣ילְךָ לִפְנֵ֣י נָדִ֑יב אֲשֶׁ֖ר רָא֣וּ עֵינֶֽיךָ׃
verses.en: For better is it that it be said unto thee: 'Come up hither', than that thou shouldest be put lower in the presence of the prince, whom thine eyes have seen.

verses.he: אַל תֵּצֵ֥א לָרִ֗ב מַ֫הֵ֥ר פֶּ֣ן מַה תַּ֭עֲשֶׂה בְּאַחֲרִיתָ֑הּ בְּהַכְלִ֖ים אֹתְךָ֣ רֵעֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: Go not forth hastily to strive, lest thou know not what to do in the end thereof, when thy neighbour hath put thee to shame.

verses.he: רִֽ֭יבְךָ רִ֣יב אֶת רֵעֶ֑ךָ וְס֖וֹד אַחֵ֣ר אַל תְּגָֽל׃
verses.en: Debate thy cause with thy neighbour, but reveal not the secret of another;

verses.he: פֶּֽן יְחַסֶּדְךָ֥ שֹׁמֵ֑עַ וְ֝דִבָּתְךָ֗ לֹ֣א תָשֽׁוּב׃
verses.en: Lest he that heareth it revile thee, and thine infamy turn not away.

verses.he: תַּפּוּחֵ֣י זָ֭הָב בְּמַשְׂכִּיּ֥וֹת כָּ֑סֶף דָּ֝בָ֗ר דָּבֻ֥ר עַל אָפְנָֽיו׃
verses.en: A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in settings of silver.

verses.he: נֶ֣זֶם זָ֭הָב וַחֲלִי כָ֑תֶם מוֹכִ֥יחַ חָ֝כָ֗ם עַל אֹ֥זֶן שֹׁמָֽעַת׃
verses.en: As an ear-ring of gold, and an ornament of fine gold, so is a wise reprover upon an obedient ear.

verses.he: כְּצִנַּת שֶׁ֨לֶג בְּי֬וֹם קָצִ֗יר צִ֣יר נֶ֭אֱמָן לְשֹׁלְחָ֑יו וְנֶ֖פֶשׁ אֲדֹנָ֣יו יָשִֽׁיב׃ פ
verses.en: As the cold of snow in the time of harvest, so is a faithful messenger to him that sendeth him; for he refresheth the soul of his master.

verses.he: נְשִׂיאִ֣ים וְ֭רוּחַ וְגֶ֣שֶׁם אָ֑יִן אִ֥ישׁ מִ֝תְהַלֵּ֗ל בְּמַתַּת שָֽׁקֶר׃
verses.en: As vapours and wind without rain, so is he that boasteth himself of a false gift.

verses.he: בְּאֹ֣רֶךְ אַ֭פַּיִם יְפֻתֶּ֣ה קָצִ֑ין וְלָשׁ֥וֹן רַ֝כָּ֗ה תִּשְׁבָּר גָּֽרֶם׃
verses.en: By long forbearing is a ruler persuaded, and a soft tongue breaketh the bone.

verses.he: דְּבַ֣שׁ מָ֭צָאתָ אֱכֹ֣ל דַּיֶּ֑ךָּ פֶּן תִּ֝שְׂבָּעֶ֗נּוּ וַהֲקֵֽאתֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Hast thou found honey? eat so much as is sufficient for thee, lest thou be filled therewith, and vomit it.

verses.he: הֹקַ֣ר רַ֭גְלְךָ מִבֵּ֣ית רֵעֶ֑ךָ פֶּן יִ֝שְׂבָּעֲךָ֗ וּשְׂנֵאֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: Let thy foot be seldom in thy neighbour's house; lest he be sated with thee, and hate thee.

verses.he: מֵפִ֣יץ וְ֭חֶרֶב וְחֵ֣ץ שָׁנ֑וּן אִ֥ישׁ עֹנֶ֥ה בְ֝רֵעֵ֗הוּ עֵ֣ד שָֽׁקֶר׃
verses.en: As a maul, and a sword, and a sharp arrow, so is a man that beareth false witness against his neighbour.

verses.he: שֵׁ֣ן רֹ֭עָה וְרֶ֣גֶל מוּעָ֑דֶת מִבְטָ֥ח בּ֝וֹגֵ֗ד בְּי֣וֹם צָרָֽה׃
verses.en: Confidence in an unfaithful man in time of trouble is like a broken tooth, and a foot out of joint.

verses.he: מַ֥עֲדֶה בֶּ֨גֶד בְּי֣וֹם קָ֭רָה חֹ֣מֶץ עַל נָ֑תֶר וְשָׁ֥ר בַּ֝שִּׁרִ֗ים עַ֣ל לֶב רָֽע׃ פ
verses.en: As one that taketh off a garment in cold weather, and as vinegar upon nitre, so is he that singeth songs to a heavy heart.

verses.he: אִם רָעֵ֣ב שֹׂ֭נַאֲךָ הַאֲכִלֵ֣הוּ לָ֑חֶם וְאִם צָ֝מֵ֗א הַשְׁקֵ֥הוּ מָֽיִם׃
verses.en: If thine enemy be hungry, give him bread to eat, and if he be thirsty, give him water to drink;

verses.he: כִּ֤י גֶֽחָלִ֗ים אַ֭תָּה חֹתֶ֣ה עַל רֹאשׁ֑וֹ וַֽ֝יהוָ֗ה יְשַׁלֶּם לָֽךְ׃
verses.en: For thou wilt heap coals of fire upon his head, and HaShem will reward thee.

verses.he: ר֣וּחַ צָ֭פוֹן תְּח֣וֹלֵֽל גָּ֑שֶׁם וּפָנִ֥ים נִ֝זְעָמִ֗ים לְשׁ֣וֹן סָֽתֶר׃
verses.en: The north wind bringeth forth rain, and a backbiting tongue an angry countenance.

verses.he: ט֗וֹב שֶׁ֥בֶת עַל פִּנַּת גָּ֑ג מֵאֵ֥שֶׁת מדוניםמדוניםמִ֝דְיָנִ֗יםוּבֵ֥ית חָֽבֶר׃
verses.en: It is better to dwell in a corner of the housetop, than in a house in common with a contentious woman.

verses.he: מַ֣יִם קָ֭רִים עַל נֶ֣פֶשׁ עֲיֵפָ֑ה וּשְׁמוּעָ֥ה ט֝וֹבָ֗ה מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מֶרְחָֽק׃
verses.en: As cold waters to a faint soul, so is good news from a far country.

verses.he: מַעְיָ֣ן נִ֭רְפָּשׂ וּמָק֣וֹר מָשְׁחָ֑ת צַ֝דִּ֗יק מָ֣ט לִפְנֵֽי רָשָֽׁע׃
verses.en: As a troubled fountain, and a corrupted spring, so is a righteous man that giveth way before the wicked.

verses.he: אָ֘כֹ֤ל דְּבַ֣שׁ הַרְבּ֣וֹת לֹא ט֑וֹב וְחֵ֖קֶר כְּבֹדָ֣ם כָּבֽוֹד׃
verses.en: It is not good to eat much honey; so for men to search out their own glory is not glory.

verses.he: עִ֣יר פְּ֭רוּצָה אֵ֣ין חוֹמָ֑ה אִ֝֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֵ֖ין מַעְצָ֣ר לְרוּחֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Like a city broken down and without a wall, so is he whose spirit is without restraint.

verses.he: כַּשֶּׁ֤לֶג בַּקַּ֗יִץ וְכַמָּטָ֥ר בַּקָּצִ֑יר כֵּ֤ן לֹא נָאוֶ֖ה לִכְסִ֣יל כָּבֽוֹד׃
verses.en: As snow in summer, and as rain in harvest, so honour is not seemly for a fool.

verses.he: כַּצִּפּ֣וֹר לָ֭נוּד כַּדְּר֣וֹר לָע֑וּף כֵּ֥ן קִֽלְלַ֥ת חִ֝נָּ֗ם לאלאל֣וֹתָבֹֽא׃
verses.en: As the wandering sparrow, as the flying swallow, so the curse that is causeless shall come home.

verses.he: שׁ֣וֹט לַ֭סּוּס מֶ֣תֶג לַחֲמ֑וֹר וְ֝שֵׁ֗בֶט לְגֵ֣ו כְּסִילִֽים׃
verses.en: A whip for the horse, a bridle for the ass, and a rod for the back of fools.

verses.he: אַל תַּ֣עַן כְּ֭סִיל כְּאִוַּלְתּ֑וֹ פֶּֽן תִּשְׁוֶה לּ֥וֹ גַם אָֽתָּה׃
verses.en: Answer not a fool according to his folly, lest thou also be like unto him.

verses.he: עֲנֵ֣ה כְ֭סִיל כְּאִוַּלְתּ֑וֹ פֶּן יִהְיֶ֖ה חָכָ֣ם בְּעֵינָֽיו׃
verses.en: Answer a fool according to his folly, lest he be wise in his own eyes.

verses.he: מְקַצֶּ֣ה רַ֭גְלַיִם חָמָ֣ס שֹׁתֶ֑ה שֹׁלֵ֖חַ דְּבָרִ֣ים בְּיַד כְּסִֽיל׃
verses.en: He that sendeth a message by the hand of a fool cutteth off his own feet, and drinketh damage.

verses.he: דַּלְי֣וּ שֹׁ֭קַיִם מִפִּסֵּ֑חַ וּ֝מָשָׁ֗ל בְּפִ֣י כְסִילִֽים׃
verses.en: The legs hang limp from the lame; so is a parable in the mouth of fools.

verses.he: כִּצְר֣וֹר אֶ֭בֶן בְּמַרְגֵּמָ֑ה כֵּן נוֹתֵ֖ן לִכְסִ֣יל כָּבֽוֹד׃
verses.en: As a small stone in a heap of stones, so is he that giveth honour to a fool.

verses.he: ח֭וֹחַ עָלָ֣ה בְיַד שִׁכּ֑וֹר וּ֝מָשָׁ֗ל בְּפִ֣י כְסִילִֽים׃
verses.en: As a thorn that cometh into the hand of a drunkard, so is a parable in the mouth of fools.

verses.he: רַ֥ב מְחֽוֹלֵֽל כֹּ֑ל וְשֹׂכֵ֥ר כְּ֝סִ֗יל וְשֹׂכֵ֥ר עֹבְרִֽים׃
verses.en: A master performeth all things; but he that stoppeth a fool is as one that stoppeth a flood.

verses.he: כְּ֭כֶלֶב שָׁ֣ב עַל קֵא֑וֹ כְּ֝סִ֗יל שׁוֹנֶ֥ה בְאִוַּלְתּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: As a dog that returneth to his vomit, so is a fool that repeateth his folly.

verses.he: רָאִ֗יתָ אִ֭ישׁ חָכָ֣ם בְּעֵינָ֑יו תִּקְוָ֖ה לִכְסִ֣יל מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.en: Seest thou a man wise in his own eyes? there is more hope of a fool than of him.

verses.he: אָמַ֣ר עָ֭צֵל שַׁ֣חַל בַּדָּ֑רֶךְ אֲ֝רִ֗י בֵּ֣ין הָרְחֹבֽוֹת׃
verses.en: The sluggard saith: 'There is a lion in the way; yea, a lion is in the streets.'

verses.he: הַ֭דֶּלֶת תִּסּ֣וֹב עַל צִירָ֑הּ וְ֝עָצֵ֗ל עַל מִטָּתֽוֹ׃
verses.en: The door is turning upon its hinges, and the sluggard is still upon his bed.

verses.he: טָ֘מַ֤ן עָצֵ֣ל יָ֭דוֹ בַּצַּלָּ֑חַת נִ֝לְאָ֗ה לַֽהֲשִׁיבָ֥הּ אֶל פִּֽיו׃
verses.en: The sluggard burieth his hand in the dish; it wearieth him to bring it back to his mouth.

verses.he: חָכָ֣ם עָצֵ֣ל בְּעֵינָ֑יו מִ֝שִּׁבְעָ֗ה מְשִׁ֣יבֵי טָֽעַם׃
verses.en: The sluggard is wiser in his own eyes than seven men that give wise answer.

verses.he: מַחֲזִ֥יק בְּאָזְנֵי כָ֑לֶב עֹבֵ֥ר מִ֝תְעַבֵּ֗ר עַל רִ֥יב לֹּֽא לֽוֹ׃
verses.en: He that passeth by, and meddleth with strife not his own, is like one that taketh a dog by the ears.

verses.he: כְּֽ֭מִתְלַהְלֵהַּ הַיֹּרֶ֥ה זִקִּ֗ים חִצִּ֥ים וָמָֽוֶת׃
verses.en: As a madman who casteth firebrands, arrows, and death;

verses.he: כֵּֽן אִ֭ישׁ רִמָּ֣ה אֶת רֵעֵ֑הוּ וְ֝אָמַ֗ר הֲֽלֹא מְשַׂחֵ֥ק אָֽנִי׃
verses.en: So is the man that deceiveth his neighbour, and saith: 'Am not I in sport?'

verses.he: בְּאֶ֣פֶס עֵ֭צִים תִּכְבֶּה אֵ֑שׁ וּבְאֵ֥ין נִ֝רְגָּ֗ן יִשְׁתֹּ֥ק מָדֽוֹן׃
verses.en: Where no wood is, the fire goeth out; and where there is no whisperer, contention ceaseth.

verses.he: פֶּחָ֣ם לְ֭גֶחָלִים וְעֵצִ֣ים לְאֵ֑שׁ וְאִ֥ישׁ מדוניםמדוניםמִ֝דְיָנִ֗יםלְחַרְחַר רִֽיב׃ פ
verses.en: As coals are to burning coals, and wood to fire; so is a contentious man to kindle strife.

verses.he: דִּבְרֵ֣י נִ֭רְגָּן כְּמִֽתְלַהֲמִ֑ים וְ֝הֵ֗ם יָרְד֥וּ חַדְרֵי בָֽטֶן׃
verses.en: The words of a whisperer are as dainty morsels, and they go down into the innermost parts of the body.

verses.he: כֶּ֣סֶף סִ֭יגִים מְצֻפֶּ֣ה עַל חָ֑רֶשׂ שְׂפָתַ֖יִם דֹּלְקִ֣ים וְלֶב רָֽע׃
verses.en: Burning lips and a wicked heart are like an earthen vessel overlaid with silver dross.

verses.he: בשפתובשפתובִּ֭שְׂפָתָיויִנָּכֵ֣ר שׂוֹנֵ֑א וּ֝בְקִרְבּ֗וֹ יָשִׁ֥ית מִרְמָֽה׃
verses.en: He that hateth dissembleth with his lips, but he layeth up deceit within him.

verses.he: כִּֽי יְחַנֵּ֣ן ק֭וֹלוֹ אַל תַּֽאֲמֶן בּ֑וֹ כִּ֤י שֶׁ֖בַע תּוֹעֵב֣וֹת בְּלִבּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: When he speaketh fair, believe him not; for there are seven abominations in his heart.

verses.he: תִּכַּסֶּ֣ה שִׂ֭נְאָה בְּמַשָּׁא֑וֹן תִּגָּלֶ֖ה רָעָת֣וֹ בְקָהָֽל׃
verses.en: Though his hatred be concealed with deceit, his wickedness shall be revealed before the congregation.

verses.he: כֹּֽרֶה שַּׁ֭חַת בָּ֣הּ יִפֹּ֑ל וְגֹ֥לֵ֥ל אֶ֝בֶן אֵלָ֥יו תָּשֽׁוּב׃
verses.en: Whoso diggeth a pit shall fall therein; and he that rolleth a stone, it shall return upon him.

verses.he: לְֽשׁוֹן שֶׁ֭קֶר יִשְׂנָ֣א דַכָּ֑יו וּפֶ֥ה חָ֝לָ֗ק יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה מִדְחֶֽה׃
verses.en: A lying tongue hateth those that are crushed by it; and a flattering mouth worketh ruin.

verses.he: אַֽל תִּ֭תְהַלֵּל בְּי֣וֹם מָחָ֑ר כִּ֤י לֹא תֵ֝דַ֗ע מַה יֵּ֥לֶד יֽוֹם׃
verses.en: Boast not thyself of to-morrow; for thou knowest not what a day may bring forth.

verses.he: יְהַלֶּלְךָ֣ זָ֣ר וְלֹא פִ֑יךָ נָ֝כְרִ֗י וְאַל שְׂפָתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.en: Let another man praise thee, and not thine own mouth; a stranger, and not thine own lips.

verses.he: כֹּֽבֶד אֶ֭בֶן וְנֵ֣טֶל הַח֑וֹל וְכַ֥עַס אֱ֝וִ֗יל כָּבֵ֥ד מִשְּׁנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.en: A stone is heavy, and the sand weighty; but a fool's vexation is heavier than they both.

verses.he: אַכְזְרִיּ֣וּת חֵ֭מָה וְשֶׁ֣טֶף אָ֑ף וּמִ֥י יַ֝עֲמֹד לִפְנֵ֥י קִנְאָֽה׃
verses.en: Wrath is cruel, and anger is overwhelming; but who is able to stand before jealousy?

verses.he: ט֭וֹבָה תּוֹכַ֣חַת מְגֻלָּ֑ה מֵֽאַהֲבָ֥ה מְסֻתָּֽרֶת׃
verses.en: Better is open rebuke than love that is hidden.

verses.he: נֶ֭אֱמָנִים פִּצְעֵ֣י אוֹהֵ֑ב וְ֝נַעְתָּר֗וֹת נְשִׁיק֥וֹת שׂוֹנֵֽא׃
verses.en: Faithful are the wounds of a friend; but the kisses of an enemy are importunate.

verses.he: נֶ֣פֶשׁ שְׂ֭בֵעָה תָּב֣וּס נֹ֑פֶת וְנֶ֥פֶשׁ רְ֝עֵבָ֗ה כָּל מַ֥ר מָתֽוֹק׃
verses.en: The full soul loatheth a honeycomb; but to the hungry soul every bitter thing is sweet.

verses.he: כְּ֭צִפּוֹר נוֹדֶ֣דֶת מִן קִנָּ֑הּ כֵּֽן אִ֝֗ישׁ נוֹדֵ֥ד מִמְּקוֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.en: As a bird that wandereth from her nest, so is a man that wandereth from his place.

verses.he: שֶׁ֣מֶן וּ֭קְטֹרֶת יְשַׂמַּֽח לֵ֑ב וּמֶ֥תֶק רֵ֝עֵ֗הוּ מֵֽעֲצַת נָֽפֶשׁ׃
verses.en: Ointment and perfume rejoice the heart; so doth the sweetness of a man's friend by hearty counsel.

verses.he: רֵֽעֲךָ֨ ורעהורעהוְרֵ֪עַאָבִ֡יךָ אַֽל תַּעֲזֹ֗ב וּבֵ֥ית אָחִ֗יךָ אַל תָּ֭בוֹא בְּי֣וֹם אֵידֶ֑ךָ ט֥וֹב שָׁכֵ֥ן קָ֝ר֗וֹב מֵאָ֥ח רָחֽוֹק׃
verses.en: Thine own friend, and thy father's friend, forsake not; neither go into thy brother's house in the day of thy calamity; better is a neighbour that is near than a brother far off.

verses.he: חֲכַ֣ם בְּ֭נִי וְשַׂמַּ֣ח לִבִּ֑י וְאָשִׁ֖יבָה חֹרְפִ֣י דָבָֽר׃
verses.en: My son, be wise, and make my heart glad, that I may answer him that taunteth me.

verses.he: עָר֤וּם רָאָ֣ה רָעָ֣ה נִסְתָּ֑ר פְּ֝תָאיִ֗ם עָבְר֥וּ נֶעֱנָֽשׁוּ׃
verses.en: A prudent man seeth the evil, and hideth himself; but the thoughtless pass on, and are punished.

verses.he: קַח בִּ֭גְדוֹ כִּי עָ֣רַב זָ֑ר וּבְעַ֖ד נָכְרִיָּ֣ה חַבְלֵֽהוּ׃
verses.en: Take his garment that is surety for a stranger; and hold him in pledge that is surety for an alien woman.

verses.he: מְבָ֘רֵ֤ךְ רֵעֵ֨הוּ בְּק֣וֹל גָּ֭דוֹל בַּבֹּ֣קֶר הַשְׁכֵּ֑ים קְ֝לָלָ֗ה תֵּחָ֥שֶׁב לֽוֹ׃
verses.en: He that blesseth his friend with a loud voice, rising early in the morning, it shall be counted a curse to him.

verses.he: דֶּ֣לֶף ט֭וֹרֵד בְּי֣וֹם סַגְרִ֑יר וְאֵ֥שֶׁת מדוניםמדוניםמִ֝דְיָנִ֗יםנִשְׁתָּוָֽה׃
verses.en: A continual dropping in a very rainy day and a contentious woman are alike;

verses.he: צֹפְנֶ֥יהָ צָֽפַן ר֑וּחַ וְשֶׁ֖מֶן יְמִינ֣וֹ יִקְרָֽא׃
verses.en: He that would hide her hideth the wind, and the ointment of his right hand betrayeth itself.

verses.he: בַּרְזֶ֣ל בְּבַרְזֶ֣ל יָ֑חַד וְ֝אִ֗ישׁ יַ֣חַד פְּנֵֽי רֵעֵֽהוּ׃
verses.en: Iron sharpeneth iron; so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend.

verses.he: נֹצֵ֣ר תְּ֭אֵנָה יֹאכַ֣ל פִּרְיָ֑הּ וְשֹׁמֵ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣יו יְכֻבָּֽד׃
verses.en: Whoso keepeth the fig-tree shall eat the fruit thereof; and he that waiteth on his master shall be honoured.

verses.he: כַּ֭מַּיִם הַפָּנִ֣ים לַפָּנִ֑ים כֵּ֤ן לֵֽב הָ֝אָדָ֗ם לָאָדָֽם׃
verses.en: As in water face answereth to face, so the heart of man to man.

verses.he: שְׁא֣וֹל ואבדהואבדהוַ֭אֲבַדּוֹלֹ֣א תִשְׂבַּ֑עְנָה וְעֵינֵ֥י הָ֝אָדָ֗ם לֹ֣א תִשְׂבַּֽעְנָה׃
verses.en: The nether-world and Destruction are never satiated; so the eyes of man are never satiated.

verses.he: מַצְרֵ֣ף לַ֭כֶּסֶף וְכ֣וּר לַזָּהָ֑ב וְ֝אִ֗ישׁ לְפִ֣י מַהֲלָלֽוֹ׃
verses.en: The refining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold, and a man is tried by his praise.

verses.he: אִ֥ם תִּכְתּֽוֹשׁ אֶת הָאֱוִ֨יל בַּֽמַּכְתֵּ֡שׁ בְּת֣וֹךְ הָ֭רִיפוֹת בַּֽעֱלִ֑י לֹא תָס֥וּר מֵ֝עָלָ֗יו אִוַּלְתּֽוֹ׃ פ
verses.en: Though thou shouldest bray a fool in a mortar with a pestle among groats, yet will not his foolishness depart from him.

verses.he: יָדֹ֣עַ תֵּ֭דַע פְּנֵ֣י צֹאנֶ֑ךָ שִׁ֥ית לִ֝בְּךָ֗ לַעֲדָרִֽים׃
verses.en: Be thou diligent to know the state of thy flocks, and look well to thy herds;

verses.he: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א לְעוֹלָ֣ם חֹ֑סֶן וְאִם נֵ֝֗זֶר לְד֣וֹר דורדורוָדֽוֹר׃
verses.en: For riches are not for ever; and doth the crown endure unto all generations?

verses.he: גָּלָ֣ה חָ֭צִיר וְנִרְאָה דֶ֑שֶׁא וְ֝נֶאֶסְפ֗וּ עִשְּׂב֥וֹת הָרִֽים׃
verses.en: When the hay is mown, and the tender grass showeth itself, and the herbs of the mountains are gathered in;

verses.he: כְּבָשִׂ֥ים לִלְבוּשֶׁ֑ךָ וּמְחִ֥יר שָׂ֝דֶ֗ה עַתּוּדִֽים׃
verses.en: The lambs will be for thy clothing, and the goats the price for a field.

verses.he: וְדֵ֤י חֲלֵ֬ב עִזִּ֗ים לְֽ֭לַחְמְךָ לְלֶ֣חֶם בֵּיתֶ֑ךָ וְ֝חַיִּ֗ים לְנַעֲרוֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.en: And there will be goats' milk enough for thy food, for the food of thy household; and maintenance for thy maidens.

verses.he: נָ֣סוּ וְאֵין רֹדֵ֣ף רָשָׁ֑ע וְ֝צַדִּיקִ֗ים כִּכְפִ֥יר יִבְטָֽח׃
verses.en: The wicked flee when no man pursueth; but the righteous are secure as a young lion.

verses.he: בְּפֶ֣שַֽׁע אֶ֭רֶץ רַבִּ֣ים שָׂרֶ֑יהָ וּבְאָדָ֥ם מֵבִ֥ין יֹ֝דֵ֗עַ כֵּ֣ן יַאֲרִֽיךְ׃
verses.en: For the transgression of a land many are the princes thereof; but by a man of understanding and knowledge established order shall long continue.

verses.he: גֶּ֣בֶר רָ֭שׁ וְעֹשֵׁ֣ק דַּלִּ֑ים מָטָ֥ר סֹ֝חֵ֗ף וְאֵ֣ין לָֽחֶם׃
verses.en: A poor man that oppresseth the weak is like a sweeping rain which leaveth no food.

verses.he: עֹזְבֵ֣י ת֭וֹרָה יְהַֽלְל֣וּ רָשָׁ֑ע וְשֹׁמְרֵ֥י ת֝וֹרָ֗ה יִתְגָּ֥רוּ בָֽם׃ פ
verses.en: They that forsake the law praise the wicked; but such as keep the law contend with them.

verses.he: אַנְשֵׁי רָ֭ע לֹא יָבִ֣ינוּ מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וּמְבַקְשֵׁ֥י יְ֝הוָ֗ה יָבִ֥ינוּ כֹֽל׃
verses.en: Evil men understand not justice; but they that seek HaShem understand all things.

verses.he: טֽוֹב רָ֭שׁ הוֹלֵ֣ךְ בְּתֻמּ֑וֹ מֵעִקֵּ֥שׁ דְּ֝רָכַ֗יִם וְה֣וּא עָשִֽׁיר׃
verses.en: Better is the poor that walketh in his integrity, than he that is perverse in his ways, though he be rich.

verses.he: נוֹצֵ֣ר תּ֭וֹרָה בֵּ֣ן מֵבִ֑ין וְרֹעֶה זֽ֝וֹלְלִ֗ים יַכְלִ֥ים אָבִֽיו׃
verses.en: A wise son observeth the teaching; but he that is a companion of gluttonous men shameth his father.

verses.he: מַרְבֶּ֣ה ה֭וֹנוֹ בְּנֶ֣שֶׁךְ ובתרביתובתרביתוְתַרְבִּ֑יתלְחוֹנֵ֖ן דַּלִּ֣ים יִקְבְּצֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.en: He that augmenteth his substance by interest and increase, gathereth it for him that is gracious to the poor.

verses.he: מֵסִ֣יר אָ֭זְנוֹ מִשְּׁמֹ֣עַ תּוֹרָ֑ה גַּֽם תְּ֝פִלָּת֗וֹ תּוֹעֵבָֽה׃
verses.en: He that turneth away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer is an abomination.

verses.he: מַשְׁגֶּ֤ה יְשָׁרִ֨ים בְּדֶ֥רֶךְ רָ֗ע בִּשְׁחוּת֥וֹ הֽוּא יִפּ֑וֹל וּ֝תְמִימִ֗ים יִנְחֲלוּ טֽוֹב׃
verses.en: Whoso causeth the upright to go astray in an evil way, he shall fall himself into his own pit; but the whole-hearted shall inherit good.

verses.he: חָכָ֣ם בְּ֭עֵינָיו אִ֣ישׁ עָשִׁ֑יר וְדַ֖ל מֵבִ֣ין יַחְקְרֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.en: The rich man is wise in his own eyes; but the poor that hath understanding searcheth him through.

verses.he: בַּעֲלֹ֣ץ צַ֭דִּיקִים רַבָּ֣ה תִפְאָ֑רֶת וּבְק֥וּם רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים יְחֻפַּ֥שׂ אָדָֽם׃
verses.en: When the righteous exult, there is great glory; but when the wicked rise, men must be sought for.

verses.he: מְכַסֶּ֣ה פְ֭שָׁעָיו לֹ֣א יַצְלִ֑יחַ וּמוֹדֶ֖ה וְעֹזֵ֣ב יְרֻחָֽם׃
verses.en: He that covereth his transgressions shall not prosper; but whoso confesseth and forsaketh them shall obtain mercy.

verses.he: אַשְׁרֵ֣י אָ֭דָם מְפַחֵ֣ד תָּמִ֑יד וּמַקְשֶׁ֥ה לִ֝בּ֗וֹ יִפּ֥וֹל בְּרָעָֽה׃
verses.en: Happy is the man that feareth alway; but he that hardeneth his heart shall fall into evil.

verses.he: אֲרִי נֹ֭הֵם וְדֹ֣ב שׁוֹקֵ֑ק מֹשֵׁ֥ל רָ֝שָׁ֗ע עַ֣ל עַם דָּֽל׃
verses.en: As a roaring lion, and a ravenous bear; so is a wicked ruler over a poor people.

verses.he: נָגִ֗יד חֲסַ֣ר תְּ֭בוּנוֹת וְרַ֥ב מַעֲשַׁקּ֑וֹת שנאישנאישֹׂ֥נֵאבֶ֝֗צַע יַאֲרִ֥יךְ יָמִֽים׃ פ
verses.en: The prince that lacketh understanding is also a great oppressor; but he that hateth covetousness shall prolong his days.

verses.he: אָ֭דָם עָשֻׁ֣ק בְּדַם נָפֶשׁ עַד בּ֥וֹר יָ֝נ֗וּס אַל יִתְמְכוּ בֽוֹ׃
verses.en: A man that is laden with the blood of any person shall hasten his steps unto the pit; none will support him.

verses.he: הוֹלֵ֣ךְ תָּ֭מִים יִוָּשֵׁ֑עַ וְנֶעְקַ֥שׁ דְּ֝רָכַ֗יִם יִפּ֥וֹל בְּאֶחָֽת׃
verses.en: Whoso walketh uprightly shall be saved; but he that is perverse in his ways shall fall at once.

verses.he: עֹבֵ֣ד אַ֭דְמָתוֹ יִֽשְׂבַּֽע לָ֑חֶם וּמְרַדֵּ֥ף רֵ֝קִ֗ים יִֽשְׂבַּֽע רִֽישׁ׃
verses.en: He that tilleth his ground shall have plenty of bread; but he that followeth after vain things shall have poverty enough.

verses.he: אִ֣ישׁ אֱ֭מוּנוֹת רַב בְּרָכ֑וֹת וְאָ֥ץ לְ֝הַעֲשִׁ֗יר לֹ֣א יִנָּקֶֽה׃
verses.en: A faithful man shall abound with blessings; but he that maketh haste to be rich shall not be unpunished.

verses.he: הַֽכֵּר פָּנִ֥ים לֹא ט֑וֹב וְעַל פַּת לֶ֝֗חֶם יִפְשַׁע גָּֽבֶר׃
verses.en: To have respect of persons is not good; for a man will transgress for a piece of bread.

verses.he: נִֽבֳהָ֥ל לַה֗וֹן אִ֭ישׁ רַ֣ע עָ֑יִן וְלֹֽא יֵ֝דַע כִּי חֶ֥סֶר יְבֹאֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.en: He that hath an evil eye hasteneth after riches, and knoweth not that want shall come upon him.

verses.he: מ֘וֹכִ֤יחַ אָדָ֣ם אַ֭חֲרַי חֵ֣ן יִמְצָ֑א מִֽמַּחֲלִ֥יק לָשֽׁוֹן׃
verses.en: He that rebuketh a man shall in the end find more favour than he that flattereth with the tongue.

verses.he: גּוֹזֵ֤ל אָ֘בִ֤יו וְאִמּ֗וֹ וְאֹמֵ֥ר אֵֽין פָּ֑שַׁע חָבֵ֥ר ה֝֗וּא לְאִ֣ישׁ מַשְׁחִֽית׃
verses.en: Whoso robbeth his father or his mother, and saith: 'It is no transgression', the same is the companion of a destroyer.

verses.he: רְחַב נֶ֭פֶשׁ יְגָרֶ֣ה מָד֑וֹן וּבוֹטֵ֖חַ עַל יְהוָ֣ה יְדֻשָּֽׁן׃
verses.en: He that is of a greedy spirit stirreth up strife; but he that putteth his trust in HaShem shall be abundantly gratified.

verses.he: בּוֹטֵ֣חַ בְּ֭לִבּוֹ ה֣וּא כְסִ֑יל וְהוֹלֵ֥ךְ בְּ֝חָכְמָ֗ה ה֣וּא יִמָּלֵֽט׃
verses.en: He that trusteth in his own heart is a fool; but whoso walketh wisely, he shall escape.

verses.he: נוֹתֵ֣ן לָ֭רָשׁ אֵ֣ין מַחְס֑וֹר וּמַעְלִ֥ים עֵ֝ינָ֗יו רַב מְאֵרֽוֹת׃
verses.en: He that giveth unto the poor shall not lack; but he that hideth his eyes shall have many a curse.

verses.he: בְּק֣וּם רְ֭שָׁעִים יִסָּתֵ֣ר אָדָ֑ם וּ֝בְאָבְדָ֗ם יִרְבּ֥וּ צַדִּיקִֽים׃
verses.en: When the wicked rise, men hide themselves; but when they perish, the righteous increase.

verses.he: אִ֣ישׁ תּ֭וֹכָחוֹת מַקְשֶׁה עֹ֑רֶף פֶּ֥תַע יִ֝שָּׁבֵ֗ר וְאֵ֣ין מַרְפֵּֽא׃
verses.en: He that being often reproved hardeneth his neck shall suddenly be broken, and that without remedy.

verses.he: בִּרְב֣וֹת צַ֭דִּיקִים יִשְׂמַ֣ח הָעָ֑ם וּבִמְשֹׁ֥ל רָ֝שָׁ֗ע יֵאָ֥נַֽח עָֽם׃
verses.en: When the righteous are increased, the people rejoice; but when the wicked beareth rule, the people sigh.

verses.he: אִֽישׁ אֹהֵ֣ב חָ֭כְמָה יְשַׂמַּ֣ח אָבִ֑יו וְרֹעֶ֥ה ז֝וֹנ֗וֹת יְאַבֶּד הֽוֹן׃
verses.en: Whoso loveth wisdom rejoiceth his father; but he that keepeth company with harlots wasteth his substance.

verses.he: מֶ֗לֶךְ בְּ֭מִשְׁפָּט יַעֲמִ֣יד אָ֑רֶץ וְאִ֖ישׁ תְּרוּמ֣וֹת יֶֽהֶרְסֶֽנָּה׃
verses.en: The king by justice establisheth the land; but he that exacteth gifts overthroweth it.

verses.he: גֶּ֭בֶר מַחֲלִ֣יק עַל רֵעֵ֑הוּ רֶ֝֗שֶׁת פּוֹרֵ֥שׂ עַל פְּעָמָֽיו׃
verses.en: A man that flattereth his neighbour spreadeth a net for his steps.

verses.he: בְּפֶ֤שַֽׁע אִ֣ישׁ רָ֣ע מוֹקֵ֑שׁ וְ֝צַדִּ֗יק יָר֥וּן וְשָׂמֵֽחַ׃
verses.en: In the transgression of an evil man there is a snare; but the righteous doth sing and rejoice.

verses.he: יֹדֵ֣עַ צַ֭דִּיק דִּ֣ין דַּלִּ֑ים רָ֝שָׁ֗ע לֹא יָבִ֥ין דָּֽעַת׃
verses.en: The righteous taketh knowledge of the cause of the poor; the wicked understandeth not knowledge.

verses.he: אַנְשֵׁ֣י לָ֭צוֹן יָפִ֣יחוּ קִרְיָ֑ה וַ֝חֲכָמִ֗ים יָשִׁ֥יבוּ אָֽף׃
verses.en: Scornful men set a city in a blaze; but wise men turn away wrath.

verses.he: אִֽישׁ חָכָ֗ם נִ֭שְׁפָּט אֶת אִ֣ישׁ אֱוִ֑יל וְרָגַ֥ז וְ֝שָׂחַ֗ק וְאֵ֣ין נָֽחַת׃
verses.en: If a wise man contendeth with a foolish man, whether he be angry or laugh, there will be no rest.

verses.he: אַנְשֵׁ֣י דָ֭מִים יִשְׂנְאוּ תָ֑ם וִֽ֝ישָׁרִ֗ים יְבַקְשׁ֥וּ נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.en: The men of blood hate him that is sincere; and as for the upright, they seek his life.

verses.he: כָּל ר֭וּחוֹ יוֹצִ֣יא כְסִ֑יל וְ֝חָכָ֗ם בְּאָח֥וֹר יְשַׁבְּחֶֽנָּה׃
verses.en: A fool spendeth all his spirit; but a wise man stilleth it within him.

verses.he: מֹ֭שֵׁל מַקְשִׁ֣יב עַל דְּבַר שָׁ֑קֶר כָּֽל מְשָׁרְתָ֥יו רְשָׁעִֽים׃
verses.en: If a ruler hearkeneth to falsehood, all his servants are wicked.

verses.he: רָ֤שׁ וְאִ֣ישׁ תְּכָכִ֣ים נִפְגָּ֑שׁוּ מֵ֤אִיר עֵינֵ֖י שְׁנֵיהֶ֣ם יְהוָֽה׃
verses.en: The poor man and the oppressor meet together; HaShem giveth light to the eyes of them both.

verses.he: מֶ֤לֶךְ שׁוֹפֵ֣ט בֶּֽאֱמֶ֣ת דַּלִּ֑ים כִּ֝סְא֗וֹ לָעַ֥ד יִכּֽוֹן׃
verses.en: The king that faithfully judgeth the poor, his throne shall be established for ever.

verses.he: שֵׁ֣בֶט וְ֭תוֹכַחַת יִתֵּ֣ן חָכְמָ֑ה וְנַ֥עַר מְ֝שֻׁלָּ֗ח מֵבִ֥ישׁ אִמּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: The rod and reproof give wisdom; but a child left to himself causeth shame to his mother.

verses.he: בִּרְב֣וֹת רְ֭שָׁעִים יִרְבֶּה פָּ֑שַׁע וְ֝צַדִּיקִ֗ים בְּֽמַפַּלְתָּ֥ם יִרְאֽוּ׃
verses.en: When the wicked are increased, transgression increaseth; but the righteous shall gaze upon their fall.

verses.he: יַסֵּ֣ר בִּ֭נְךָ וִֽינִיחֶ֑ךָ וְיִתֵּ֖ן מַעֲדַנִּ֣ים לְנַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃ פ
verses.en: Correct thy son, and he will give thee rest; yea, he will give delight unto thy soul.

verses.he: בְּאֵ֣ין חָ֭זוֹן יִפָּ֣רַֽע עָ֑ם וְשֹׁמֵ֖ר תּוֹרָ֣ה אַשְׁרֵֽהוּ׃
verses.en: Where there is no vision, the people cast off restraint; but he that keepeth the law, happy is he.

verses.he: בִּ֭דְבָרִים לֹא יִוָּ֣סֶר עָ֑בֶד כִּֽי יָ֝בִ֗ין וְאֵ֣ין מַעֲנֶֽה׃
verses.en: A servant will not be corrected by words; for though he understand, there will be no response.

verses.he: חָזִ֗יתָ אִ֭ישׁ אָ֣ץ בִּדְבָרָ֑יו תִּקְוָ֖ה לִכְסִ֣יל מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.en: Seest thou a man that is hasty in his words? there is more hope for a fool than for him.

verses.he: מְפַנֵּ֣ק מִנֹּ֣עַר עַבְדּ֑וֹ וְ֝אַחֲרִית֗וֹ יִהְיֶ֥ה מָנֽוֹן׃
verses.en: He that delicately bringeth up his servant from a child shall have him become master at the last.

verses.he: אִֽישׁ אַ֭ף יְגָרֶ֣ה מָד֑וֹן וּבַ֖עַל חֵמָ֣ה רַב פָּֽשַׁע׃
verses.en: An angry man stirreth up strife, and a wrathful man aboundeth in transgression.

verses.he: גַּאֲוַ֣ת אָ֭דָם תַּשְׁפִּילֶ֑נּוּ וּשְׁפַל ר֝֗וּחַ יִתְמֹ֥ךְ כָּבֽוֹד׃
verses.en: A man's pride shall bring him low; but he that is of a lowly spirit shall attain to honour.

verses.he: חוֹלֵ֣ק עִם גַּ֭נָּב שׂוֹנֵ֣א נַפְשׁ֑וֹ אָלָ֥ה יִ֝שְׁמַ֗ע וְלֹ֣א יַגִּֽיד׃
verses.en: Whoso is partner with a thief hateth his own soul: he heareth the adjuration and uttereth nothing.

verses.he: חֶרְדַּ֣ת אָ֭דָם יִתֵּ֣ן מוֹקֵ֑שׁ וּבוֹטֵ֖חַ בַּיהוָ֣ה יְשֻׂגָּֽב׃
verses.en: The fear of man bringeth a snare; but whoso putteth his trust in HaShem shall be set up on high.

verses.he: רַ֭בִּים מְבַקְשִׁ֣ים פְּנֵי מוֹשֵׁ֑ל וּ֝מֵיְהוָ֗ה מִשְׁפַּט אִֽישׁ׃
verses.en: Many seek the ruler's favour; but a man's judgment cometh from HaShem.

verses.he: תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת צַ֭דִּיקִים אִ֣ישׁ עָ֑וֶל וְתוֹעֲבַ֖ת רָשָׁ֣ע יְשַׁר דָּֽרֶךְ׃ פ
verses.en: An unjust man is an abomination to the righteous; and he that is upright in the way is an abomination to the wicked.

verses.he: דִּבְרֵ֤י אָג֥וּר בִּן יָקֶ֗ה הַמַּ֫שָּׂ֥א נְאֻ֣ם הַ֭גֶּבֶר לְאִֽיתִיאֵ֑ל לְאִ֖יתִיאֵ֣ל וְאֻכָֽל׃
verses.en: The words of Agur the son of Jakeh; the burden. The man saith unto Ithiel, unto Ithiel and Ucal:

verses.he: כִּ֤י בַ֣עַר אָנֹכִ֣י מֵאִ֑ישׁ וְלֹֽא בִינַ֖ת אָדָ֣ם לִֽי׃
verses.en: Surely I am brutish, unlike a man, and have not the understanding of a man;

verses.he: וְלֹֽא לָמַ֥דְתִּי חָכְמָ֑ה וְדַ֖עַת קְדֹשִׁ֣ים אֵדָֽע׃
verses.en: And I have not learned wisdom, that I should have the knowledge of the Holy One.

verses.he: מִ֤י עָלָֽה שָׁמַ֨יִם וַיֵּרַ֡ד מִ֤י אָֽסַף ר֨וּחַ בְּחָפְנָ֡יו מִ֤י צָֽרַר מַ֨יִם בַּשִּׂמְלָ֗ה מִ֭י הֵקִ֣ים כָּל אַפְסֵי אָ֑רֶץ מַה שְּׁמ֥וֹ וּמַֽה שֶּׁם בְּ֝נ֗וֹ כִּ֣י תֵדָֽע׃
verses.en: Who hath ascended up into heaven, and descended? Who hath gathered the wind in his fists? Who hath bound the waters in his garment? Who hath established all the ends of the earth? What is his name, and what is his son's name, if thou knowest?

verses.he: כָּל אִמְרַ֣ת אֱל֣וֹהַּ צְרוּפָ֑ה מָגֵ֥ן ה֝֗וּא לַֽחֹסִ֥ים בּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Every word of G-d is tried; He is a shield unto them that take refuge in Him.

verses.he: אַל תּ֥וֹסְףְּ עַל דְּבָרָ֑יו פֶּן יוֹכִ֖יחַ בְּךָ֣ וְנִכְזָֽבְתָּ׃ פ
verses.en: Add thou not unto His words, lest He reprove thee, and thou be found a liar.

verses.he: שְׁ֭תַּיִם שָׁאַ֣לְתִּי מֵאִתָּ֑ךְ אַל תִּמְנַ֥ע מִ֝מֶּ֗נִּי בְּטֶ֣רֶם אָמֽוּת׃
verses.en: Two things have I asked of Thee; deny me them not before I die:

verses.he: שָׁ֤וְא וּֽדְבַר כָּזָ֡ב הַרְחֵ֬ק מִמֶּ֗נִּי רֵ֣אשׁ וָ֭עֹשֶׁר אַל תִּֽתֶּן לִ֑י הַ֝טְרִיפֵ֗נִי לֶ֣חֶם חֻקִּֽי׃
verses.en: Remove far from me falsehood and lies; give me neither poverty nor riches; feed me with mine allotted bread;

verses.he: פֶּ֥ן אֶשְׂבַּ֨ע וְכִחַשְׁתִּי֮ וְאָמַ֗רְתִּי מִ֥י יְה֫וָ֥ה וּפֶֽן אִוָּרֵ֥שׁ וְגָנַ֑בְתִּי וְ֝תָפַ֗שְׂתִּי שֵׁ֣ם אֱלֹהָֽי׃ פ
verses.en: Lest I be full, and deny, and say: 'Who is HaShem?' Or lest I be poor, and steal, and profane the name of my G-d.

verses.he: אַל תַּלְשֵׁ֣ן עֶ֭בֶד אֶל אדנואדנואֲדֹנָ֑יופֶּֽן יְקַלֶּלְךָ֥ וְאָשָֽׁמְתָּ׃
verses.en: Slander not a servant unto his master, lest he curse thee, and thou be found guilty.

verses.he: דּ֭וֹר אָבִ֣יו יְקַלֵּ֑ל וְאֶת אִ֝מּ֗וֹ לֹ֣א יְבָרֵֽךְ׃
verses.en: There is a generation that curse their father, and do not bless their mother.

verses.he: דּ֭וֹר טָה֣וֹר בְּעֵינָ֑יו וּ֝מִצֹּאָת֗וֹ לֹ֣א רֻחָֽץ׃
verses.en: There is a generation that are pure in their own eyes, and yet are not washed from their filthiness.

verses.he: דּ֭וֹר מָה רָמ֣וּ עֵינָ֑יו וְ֝עַפְעַפָּ֗יו יִנָּשֵֽׂאוּ׃
verses.en: There is a generation, Oh how lofty are their eyes! and their eyelids are lifted up.

verses.he: דּ֤וֹר חֲרָב֣וֹת שִׁנָּיו֮ וּֽמַאֲכָל֪וֹת מְֽתַלְּעֹ֫תָ֥יו לֶאֱכֹ֣ל עֲנִיִּ֣ים מֵאֶ֑רֶץ וְ֝אֶבְיוֹנִ֗ים מֵאָדָֽם׃ פ
verses.en: There is a generation whose teeth are as swords, and their great teeth as knives, to devour the poor from off the earth, and the needy from among men.

verses.he: לַֽעֲלוּקָ֨ה שְׁתֵּ֥י בָנוֹת֮ הַ֤ב הַ֥ב שָׁל֣וֹשׁ הֵ֭נָּה לֹ֣א תִשְׂבַּ֑עְנָה אַ֝רְבַּ֗ע לֹא אָ֥מְרוּ הֽוֹן׃
verses.en: The horseleech hath two daughters: 'Give, give.' There are three things that are never satisfied, yea, four that say not: 'Enough':

verses.he: שְׁאוֹל֮ וְעֹ֪צֶ֫ר רָ֥חַם אֶ֭רֶץ לֹא שָׂ֣בְעָה מַּ֑יִם וְ֝אֵ֗שׁ לֹא אָ֥מְרָה הֽוֹן׃
verses.en: The grave; and the barren womb; the earth that is not satisfied with water; and the fire that saith not: 'Enough.'

verses.he: עַ֤יִן תִּֽלְעַ֣ג לְאָב֮ וְתָב֪וּז לִֽיקֲּהַ֫ת אֵ֥ם יִקְּר֥וּהָ עֹרְבֵי נַ֑חַל וְֽיֹאכְל֥וּהָ בְנֵי נָֽשֶׁר׃ פ
verses.en: The eye that mocketh at his father, and despiseth to obey his mother, the ravens of the valley shall pick it out, and the young vultures shall eat it.

verses.he: שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה הֵ֭מָּה נִפְלְא֣וּ מִמֶּ֑נִּי וארבעוארבעוְ֝אַרְבָּעָ֗הלֹ֣א יְדַעְתִּֽים׃
verses.en: There are three things which are too wonderful for me, yea, four which I know not:

verses.he: דֶּ֤רֶךְ הַנֶּ֨שֶׁר בַּשָּׁמַיִם֮ דֶּ֥רֶךְ נָחָ֗שׁ עֲלֵ֫י צ֥וּר דֶּֽרֶךְ אֳנִיָּ֥ה בְלֶב יָ֑ם וְדֶ֖רֶךְ גֶּ֣בֶר בְּעַלְמָֽה׃
verses.en: The way of an eagle in the air; the way of a serpent upon a rock; the way of a ship in the midst of the sea; and the way of a man with a young woman.

verses.he: כֵּ֤ן דֶּ֥רֶךְ אִשָּׁ֗ה מְנָ֫אָ֥פֶת אָ֭כְלָה וּמָ֣חֲתָה פִ֑יהָ וְ֝אָמְרָ֗ה לֹֽא פָעַ֥לְתִּי אָֽוֶן׃ פ
verses.en: So is the way of an adulterous woman; she eateth, and wipeth her mouth, and saith: 'I have done no wickedness.'

verses.he: תַּ֣חַת שָׁ֭לוֹשׁ רָ֣גְזָה אֶ֑רֶץ וְתַ֥חַת אַ֝רְבַּ֗ע לֹא תוּכַ֥ל שְׂאֵֽת׃
verses.en: For three things the earth doth quake, and for four it cannot endure:

verses.he: תַּֽחַת עֶ֭בֶד כִּ֣י יִמְל֑וֹךְ וְ֝נָבָ֗ל כִּ֣י יִֽשְׂבַּֽע לָֽחֶם׃
verses.en: For a servant when he reigneth; and a churl when he is filled with food;

verses.he: תַּ֣חַת שְׂ֭נוּאָה כִּ֣י תִבָּעֵ֑ל וְ֝שִׁפְחָ֗ה כִּֽי תִירַ֥שׁ גְּבִרְתָּֽהּ׃ פ
verses.en: For an odious woman when she is married; and a handmaid that is heir to her mistress.

verses.he: אַרְבָּ֣עָה הֵ֭ם קְטַנֵּי אָ֑רֶץ וְ֝הֵ֗מָּה חֲכָמִ֥ים מְחֻכָּמִֽים׃
verses.en: There are four things which are little upon the earth, but they are exceeding wise:

verses.he: הַ֭נְּמָלִים עַ֣ם לֹא עָ֑ז וַיָּכִ֖ינוּ בַקַּ֣יִץ לַחְמָֽם׃
verses.en: The ants are a people not strong, yet they provide their food in the summer;

verses.he: שְׁ֭פַנִּים עַ֣ם לֹא עָצ֑וּם וַיָּשִׂ֖ימוּ בַסֶּ֣לַע בֵּיתָֽם׃
verses.en: The rock-badgers are but a feeble folk, yet make they their houses in the crags;

verses.he: מֶ֭לֶךְ אֵ֣ין לָאַרְבֶּ֑ה וַיֵּצֵ֖א חֹצֵ֣ץ כֻּלּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: The locusts have no king, yet go they forth all of them by bands;

verses.he: שְׂ֭מָמִית בְּיָדַ֣יִם תְּתַפֵּ֑שׂ וְ֝הִ֗יא בְּהֵ֣יכְלֵי מֶֽלֶךְ׃ פ
verses.en: The spider thou canst take with the hands, yet is she in kings' palaces.

verses.he: שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה הֵ֭מָּה מֵיטִ֣יבֵי צָ֑עַד וְ֝אַרְבָּעָ֗ה מֵיטִ֥בֵי לָֽכֶת׃
verses.en: There are three things which are stately in their march, yea, four which are stately in going:

verses.he: לַ֭יִשׁ גִּבּ֣וֹר בַּבְּהֵמָ֑ה וְלֹא יָ֝שׁ֗וּב מִפְּנֵי כֹֽל׃
verses.en: The lion, which is mightiest among beasts, and turneth not away for any;

verses.he: זַרְזִ֣יר מָתְנַ֣יִם אוֹ תָ֑יִשׁ וּ֝מֶ֗לֶךְ אַלְק֥וּם עִמּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: The greyhound; the he-goat also; and the king, against whom there is no rising up.

verses.he: אִם נָבַ֥לְתָּ בְהִתְנַשֵּׂ֑א וְאִם זַ֝מּ֗וֹתָ יָ֣ד לְפֶֽה׃
verses.en: If thou hast done foolishly in lifting up thyself, or if thou hast planned devices, lay thy hand upon thy mouth.
