verses.he: כִּ֤י מִ֪יץ חָלָ֡ב י֘וֹצִ֤יא חֶמְאָ֗ה וּֽמִיץ אַ֭ף י֣וֹצִיא דָ֑ם וּמִ֥יץ אַ֝פַּ֗יִם י֣וֹצִיא רִֽיב׃ פ
verses.en: For the churning of milk bringeth forth curd, and the wringing of the nose bringeth forth blood; so the forcing of wrath bringeth forth strife.

verses.he: דִּ֭בְרֵי לְמוּאֵ֣ל מֶ֑לֶךְ מַ֝שָּׂ֗א אֲֽשֶׁר יִסְּרַ֥תּוּ אִמּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: The words of king Lemuel; the burden wherewith his mother corrected him.

verses.he: מַה בְּ֭רִי וּמַֽה בַּר בִּטְנִ֑י וּ֝מֶה בַּר נְדָרָֽי׃
verses.en: What, my son? and what, O son of my womb? and what, O son of my vows?

verses.he: אַל תִּתֵּ֣ן לַנָּשִׁ֣ים חֵילֶ֑ךָ וּ֝דְרָכֶ֗יךָ לַֽמְח֥וֹת מְלָכִֽין׃
verses.en: Give not thy strength unto women, nor thy ways to that which destroyeth kings.

verses.he: אַ֤ל לַֽמְלָכִ֨ים לְֽמוֹאֵ֗ל אַ֣ל לַֽמְלָכִ֣ים שְׁתוֹ יָ֑יִן וּ֝לְרוֹזְנִ֗ים אואואֵ֣ישֵׁכָֽר׃
verses.en: It is not for kings, O Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine: nor for princes to say: 'Where is strong drink?'

verses.he: פֶּן יִ֭שְׁתֶּה וְיִשְׁכַּ֣ח מְחֻקָּ֑ק וִֽ֝ישַׁנֶּה דִּ֣ין כָּל בְּנֵי עֹֽנִי׃
verses.en: Lest they drink, and forget that which is decreed, and pervert the justice due to any that is afflicted.

verses.he: תְּנוּ שֵׁכָ֣ר לְאוֹבֵ֑ד וְ֝יַיִן לְמָ֣רֵי נָֽפֶשׁ׃
verses.en: Give strong drink unto him that is ready to perish, and wine unto the bitter in soul;

verses.he: יִ֭שְׁתֶּה וְיִשְׁכַּ֣ח רִישׁ֑וֹ וַ֝עֲמָל֗וֹ לֹ֣א יִזְכָּר עֽוֹד׃
verses.en: Let him drink, and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more.

verses.he: פְּתַח פִּ֥יךָ לְאִלֵּ֑ם אֶל דִּ֝֗ין כָּל בְּנֵ֥י חֲלֽוֹף׃
verses.en: Open thy mouth for the dumb, in the cause of all such as are appointed to destruction.

verses.he: פְּתַח פִּ֥יךָ שְׁפָט צֶ֑דֶק וְ֝דִ֗ין עָנִ֥י וְאֶבְיֽוֹן׃ פ
verses.en: Open thy mouth, judge righteously, and plead the cause of the poor and needy.

verses.he: אֵֽשֶׁת חַ֭יִל מִ֣י יִמְצָ֑א וְרָחֹ֖ק מִפְּנִינִ֣ים מִכְרָֽהּ׃
verses.en: A woman of valour who can find? for her price is far above rubies.

verses.he: בָּ֣טַח בָּ֭הּ לֵ֣ב בַּעְלָ֑הּ וְ֝שָׁלָ֗ל לֹ֣א יֶחְסָֽר׃
verses.en: The heart of her husband doth safely trust in her, and he hath no lack of gain.

verses.he: גְּמָלַ֣תְהוּ ט֣וֹב וְלֹא רָ֑ע כֹּ֝֗ל יְמֵ֣י חַיֶּֽיה׃
verses.en: She doeth him good and not evil all the days of her life.

verses.he: דָּ֭רְשָׁה צֶ֣מֶר וּפִשְׁתִּ֑ים וַ֝תַּ֗עַשׂ בְּחֵ֣פֶץ כַּפֶּֽיהָ׃
verses.en: She seeketh wool and flax, and worketh willingly with her hands.

verses.he: הָ֭יְתָה כָּאֳנִיּ֣וֹת סוֹחֵ֑ר מִ֝מֶּרְחָ֗ק תָּבִ֥יא לַחְמָֽהּ׃
verses.en: She is like the merchant-ships; she bringeth her food from afar.

verses.he: וַתָּ֤קָם בְּע֬וֹד לַ֗יְלָה וַתִּתֵּ֣ן טֶ֣רֶף לְבֵיתָ֑הּ וְ֝חֹ֗ק לְנַעֲרֹתֶֽיהָ׃
verses.en: She riseth also while it is yet night, and giveth food to her household, and a portion to her maidens.

verses.he: זָמְמָ֣ה שָׂ֭דֶה וַתִּקָּחֵ֑הוּ מִפְּרִ֥י כַ֝פֶּ֗יהָ נטענטענָ֣טְעָהכָּֽרֶם׃
verses.en: She considereth a field, and buyeth it; with the fruit of her hands she planteth a vineyard.

verses.he: חָֽגְרָ֣ה בְע֣וֹז מָתְנֶ֑יהָ וַ֝תְּאַמֵּ֗ץ זְרֹעוֹתֶֽיהָ׃
verses.en: She girdeth her loins with strength, and maketh strong her arms.

verses.he: טָ֭עֲמָה כִּי ט֣וֹב סַחְרָ֑הּ לֹֽא יִכְבֶּ֖ה בלילבלילבַלַּ֣יְלָהנֵרָֽהּ׃
verses.en: She perceiveth that her merchandise is good; her lamp goeth not out by night.

verses.he: יָ֭דֶיהָ שִׁלְּחָ֣ה בַכִּישׁ֑וֹר וְ֝כַפֶּ֗יהָ תָּ֣מְכוּ פָֽלֶךְ׃
verses.en: She layeth her hands to the distaff, and her hands hold the spindle.

verses.he: כַּ֭פָּהּ פָּרְשָׂ֣ה לֶעָנִ֑י וְ֝יָדֶ֗יהָ שִׁלְּחָ֥ה לָֽאֶבְיֽוֹן׃
verses.en: She stretcheth out her hand to the poor; yea, she reacheth forth her hands to the needy.

verses.he: לֹא תִירָ֣א לְבֵיתָ֣הּ מִשָּׁ֑לֶג כִּ֥י כָל בֵּ֝יתָ֗הּ לָבֻ֥שׁ שָׁנִֽים׃
verses.en: She is not afraid of the snow for her household; for all her household are clothed with scarlet.

verses.he: מַרְבַדִּ֥ים עָֽשְׂתָה לָּ֑הּ שֵׁ֖שׁ וְאַרְגָּמָ֣ן לְבוּשָֽׁהּ׃
verses.en: She maketh for herself coverlets; her clothing is fine linen and purple.

verses.he: נוֹדָ֣ע בַּשְּׁעָרִ֣ים בַּעְלָ֑הּ בְּ֝שִׁבְתּ֗וֹ עִם זִקְנֵי אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.en: Her husband is known in the gates, when he sitteth among the elders of the land.

verses.he: סָדִ֣ין עָ֭שְׂתָה וַתִּמְכֹּ֑ר וַ֝חֲג֗וֹר נָתְנָ֥ה לַֽכְּנַעֲנִֽי׃
verses.en: She maketh linen garments and selleth them; and delivereth girdles unto the merchant.

verses.he: עֹז וְהָדָ֥ר לְבוּשָׁ֑הּ וַ֝תִּשְׂחַ֗ק לְי֣וֹם אַחֲרֽוֹן׃
verses.en: Strength and dignity are her clothing; and she laugheth at the time to come.

verses.he: פִּ֭יהָ פָּתְחָ֣ה בְחָכְמָ֑ה וְתֽוֹרַת חֶ֝֗סֶד עַל לְשׁוֹנָֽהּ׃
verses.en: She openeth her mouth with wisdom; and the law of kindness is on her tongue.

verses.he: צ֭וֹפִיָּה הֲלִיכ֣וֹת בֵּיתָ֑הּ וְלֶ֥חֶם עַ֝צְל֗וּת לֹ֣א תֹאכֵֽל׃
verses.en: She looketh well to the ways of her household, and eateth not the bread of idleness.

verses.he: קָ֣מוּ בָ֭נֶיהָ וַֽיְאַשְּׁר֑וּהָ בַּ֝עְלָ֗הּ וַֽיְהַֽלְלָהּ׃
verses.en: Her children rise up, and call her blessed; her husband also, and he praiseth her:

verses.he: רַבּ֣וֹת בָּ֭נוֹת עָ֣שׂוּ חָ֑יִל וְ֝אַ֗תְּ עָלִ֥ית עַל כֻּלָּֽנָה׃
verses.en: 'Many daughters have done valiantly, but thou excellest them all.'

verses.he: שֶׁ֣קֶר הַ֭חֵן וְהֶ֣בֶל הַיֹּ֑פִי אִשָּׁ֥ה יִרְאַת יְ֝הוָ֗ה הִ֣יא תִתְהַלָּֽל׃
verses.en: Grace is deceitful, and beauty is vain; but a woman that feareth HaShem, she shall be praised.

verses.he: תְּנוּ לָ֭הּ מִפְּרִ֣י יָדֶ֑יהָ וִֽיהַלְל֖וּהָ בַשְּׁעָרִ֣ים מַעֲשֶֽׂיהָ׃
verses.en: Give her of the fruit of her hands; and let her works praise her in the gates.
